Title: 1. Lady and the Tramp
description: The romantic tale of a sheltered uptown Cocker Spaniel dog and a streetwise downtown Mutt.

Title: 2. Kiss Me Deadly
description: A doomed hitchhiker pulls a tough private investigator into a deadly whirlpool of intrigue.

Title: 3. Rififi
description: Four men plan a technically perfect crime, but the human element intervenes...

Title: 4. Rebel Without a Cause
description: A rebellious young man with a troubled past comes to a new town, finding friends and enemies.

Title: 5. Pather Panchali
description: Impoverished priest Harihar Ray, dreaming of a better life for himself and his family, leaves his rural Bengal village in search of work.

Title: 6. Lola Montès
description: When she is reduced to appearing in a circus, a notorious beauty thinks back on her past loves.

Title: 7. Le amiche
description: A young woman returns to her hometown of Turin to set up a new fashion salon and gets involved with a troubled woman and her three wealthy friends.

Title: 8. I Live in Fear
description: An aging Japanese industrialist becomes so fearful of nuclear war that it begins to take a toll on his life and family.

Title: 9. The Ladykillers
description: Five oddball criminals planning a bank robbery rent rooms on a cul-de-sac from an octogenarian widow under the pretext that they are classical musicians.

Title: 10. East of Eden
description: Two brothers in 1910s California struggle to maintain the favor of their affectionate but strict, Bible-toting father as an old secret about their long-absent mother comes to light.

Title: 11. The Night of the Hunter
description: A self-proclaimed preacher marries a gullible widow whose young children are reluctant to tell him where their real dad hid the $10,000 he'd stolen in a robbery.

Title: 12. To Catch a Thief
description: A retired jewel thief sets out to prove his innocence after being suspected of returning to his former occupation.

Title: 13. Diabolique
description: The wife and mistress of a loathed school principal plan to murder him with what they believe is the perfect alibi.

Title: 14. The Trouble with Harry
description: Harry's dead and, while no one really minds, everyone feels responsible. After Harry's body is found in the woods, several locals must determine not only how and why he was killed but what to do with the body.

Title: 15. Killer's Kiss
description: Ready to catch a train to his hometown, a washed-up boxer tells us about the strange and twisty events that happened to him the past couple of days.

Title: 16. The Seven Year Itch
description: When his family goes away for summer vacation, a hitherto faithful husband with an overactive imagination is tempted by a sexy new neighbor.

Title: 17. Marty
description: A middle-aged butcher and a school teacher who have given up on the idea of love meet at a dance and fall for each other.

Title: 18. Ordet
description: A devout Danish family wrestle with their inner demons while also negotiating conflict with each other and the rest of the town.

Title: 19. Oklahoma!
description: In Oklahoma, several farmers, cowboys and a traveling salesman compete for the romantic favors of various local ladies.

Title: 20. The Man with the Golden Arm
description: A junkie must face his true self to kick his drug addiction.

Title: 21. Guys and Dolls
description: In New York, a gambler is challenged to take a cold female missionary to Havana, but they fall for each other, and the bet has a hidden motive to finance a crap game.

Title: 22. Bad Day at Black Rock
description: Following World War II, a one-armed stranger arrives in a tiny California desert town, but finds the residents hostile and protecting a terrible secret they want to keep hidden, by violent means if necessary.

Title: 23. The Quatermass Xperiment
description: Professor Bernard Quatermass' manned rocket ship returns to Earth, but two of the astronauts are missing and the survivor seems ill and unable to communicate.

Title: 24. Tarantula
description: A spider escapes from an isolated Arizona desert laboratory experimenting in gigantism and grows to tremendous size as it wreaks havoc on the local inhabitants.

Title: 25. The Miracle of Marcelino
description: In 1950s Spain, a young orphan boy living with monks discovers a wooden Jesus figure in the monastery's attic. After sharing his bread with it, a miracle occurs, leading him to make a heartfelt wish.

Title: 26. The Big Combo
description: A police lieutenant is ordered to stop investigating deadly crime boss Mr. Brown because he hasn't been able to get any hard evidence against him. He goes after Brown's girlfriend, who despises him, for information instead.

Title: 27. Summertime
description: An American spinster's dream of romance finally becomes a bittersweet reality when she meets a handsome--but married--Italian man while vacationing in Venice.

Title: 28. Smiles of a Summer Night
description: In Sweden at the turn of the century, members of the upper class and their servants find themselves in a romantic tangle that they try to work out amidst jealousy and heartbreak.

Title: 29. The Swindle
description: A trio of con-men led by a lonesome swindler must deal with their job and family pressures.

Title: 30. All That Heaven Allows
description: An upper-class widow falls in love with a much younger, down-to-earth nurseryman, much to the disapproval of her children and criticism of her country club peers.

Title: 31. The Criminal Life of Archibaldo de la Cruz
description: The delirious journey of a mentally-disordered man who is obsessed with committing the perfect crime.

Title: 32. Blackboard Jungle
description: A new English teacher at a violent, unruly inner-city school is determined to do his job, despite resistance from both students and faculty.

Title: 33. Godzilla Raids Again
description: Scouter pilots are horrified to discover a second Godzilla engaged in conflict with a new rival monster that threatens Japan once more.

Title: 34. The Girl in the Red Velvet Swing
description: The Girl in the Red Velvet Swing is the true story of Evelyn Nesbit (Dame Joan Collins), a beautiful showgirl caught in a love triangle with elderly architect Stanford White (Ray Milland) and eccentric young millionaire Harry K. Thaw (Farley Granger).

Title: 35. Confidential Report
description: An elusive billionaire hires an American smuggler to investigate his past, leading to a dizzying descent into a cold-war European landscape.

Title: 36. Hit the Deck
description: Three sailors come ashore in San Francisco and take the city by storm, but can they win the hearts of three women by song?

Title: 37. The Rose Tattoo
description: A Sicilian seamstress who idolizes her husband must deal with several family crises upon his sudden death.

Title: 38. A Journey to the Beginning of Time
description: One day a young boy finds a fossil of trilobite. Together with his three friends they set off on an adventurous journey through prehistory, up to the beginning of time.

Title: 39. Mister Roberts
description: In the waning days of World War II, the cargo officer of a Navy supply ship chafes at its role far from the action in the Pacific's backwater areas, his frustration rising when its captain denies the crew liberty over petty irritations.

Title: 40. The Left Hand of God
description: At a Catholic mission in China, long-awaited "Father O'Shea" proves to be a tough guy, disturbingly attractive to mission nurse Anne.

Title: 41. Dreams
description: Two different women - a young photo model and her boss - dream about a happy life with beloved men. Their dreams are as different as they are.

Title: 42. Picnic
description: Emotions are ignited among the complacent townsfolk of a small Kansas community when a handsome drifter arrives on the morning of the Labor Day picnic.

Title: 43. This Island Earth
description: The 1955 science fiction movie "This Island Earth" tells the story of when aliens have landed and are hiding on Earth, but need Earth's scientists to help them fight an inter-planetary war.

Title: 44. Violent Saturday
description: Three hoodlums carefully case a small town while planning to rob the bank on the upcoming Saturday. On Saturday, things turn violent and deadly.

Title: 45. A Lawless Street
description: Marshal Calem Ware must face unpleasant facts about his past when he attempts to run a criminal gang out of town.

Title: 46. My Sister Eileen
description: After submitting a story of her beautiful sister, a woman assumes her identity to maintain the attention of a playboy publisher.

Title: 47. To Hell and Back
description: The true WWII story of Audie Murphy, the most decorated soldier in U.S. history. Based on the autobiography of Audie Murphy who stars as himself in the film.

Title: 48. Revenge of the Creature
description: Men capture the Creature from the Black Lagoon and make him an aquarium attraction, from which he escapes.

Title: 49. Richard III
description: A tale of the wicked deformed King and his conquests, both on the battlefield and in the boudoir.

Title: 50. The Violent Men
description: A bitter land dispute causes a Civil War veteran to take extreme action.

Title: 51. Samurai II: Duel at Ichijoji Temple
description: Musashi Miyamoto returns to Kyoto after years of absence. After a series of fights against the Yoshioka School, he challenges its master to a duel.

Title: 52. Devdas
description: The scion of a wealthy landowner family turns to alcohol and self-pity and slowly self-destructs after class differences force him to break off his relationship with his childhood sweetheart.

Title: 53. Francis in the Navy
description: A story following Lieutenant Peter Stirling (Donald O'Connor) and his dream of being in the Navy.

Title: 54. Footsteps in the Fog
description: In early-1900s England, a maid tries to blackmail her master into romancing her when she discovers that he murdered his wife.

Title: 55. The Twinkle in God's Eye
description: A reverend goes West to a town where the Indians killed his priest-father and burned his church but the local townsfolk are keener about cash than religion.

Title: 56. Rio, 40 Degrees
description: Set during an oppressively hot day in Rio de Janeiro, the film follows five young Black boys who sell peanuts to survive, moving through different parts of the city-from wealthy beachfront neighborhoods to impoverished favelas. As they navigate their daily routines, the story weaves together multiple encounters with tourists, football fans, middle-class families, criminals, and police.

Title: 57. The Man Who Loved Redheads
description: Mark St. Neots, a charming comedy, meets Sylvia and pursues a career in the diplomatic corps. His image is shaped by her, allowing him to meet many beautiful women.

Title: 58. The Cobweb
description: At a private psychiatric clinic, the daily dramas and interactions between the doctors, nurses, administrators, benefactors and patients are accentuated by the personal and family crises of these individuals.

Title: 59. The Glass Slipper
description: Tomboyish outcast "Cinder" Ella and the duke's charming son Charles fall in love in this comedic rendition of the classic fairy tale.

Title: 60. The Court Jester
description: A hapless carnival performer masquerades as the court jester as part of a plot against an evil ruler who has overthrown the rightful King.

Title: 61. Sissi
description: In the first of a trilogy of movies about Elisabeth "Sissi" of Austria, the vibrant young princess catches the eye of her sister's fiancé, Emperor Franz Josef.

Title: 62. The Dam Busters
description: Drama based on the attempt by the RAF to destroy six dams in Germany during World War II.

Title: 63. I Died a Thousand Times
description: After aging criminal Roy Earle is released from prison he decides to pull one last heist before retiring - by robbing a resort hotel.

Title: 64. The Man from Laramie
description: Newcomer Will Lockhart defies the local cattle baron and his sadistic son by working for one of his oldest rivals.

Title: 65. Ten Wanted Men
description: After Wick Campbell's ward seeks protection with rival cattleman John Stewart, the embittered, jealous rancher hires ten outlaws to help him seize power in the territory.

Title: 66. The Desperate Hours
description: Three escaped convicts move in on and terrorize a suburban household.

Title: 67. Davy Crockett: King of the Wild Frontier
description: American frontiersman Davy Crockett fights in the Creek Indian War, is elected to the U.S. Congress and fights for Texas at the Alamo.

Title: 68. Not as a Stranger
description: Intolerant of the weaknesses of others, especially those closest to him, an ego-driven aspiring physician comes to grips with his own imperfections.

Title: 69. Moonfleet
description: A young orphan is sent to the village of Moonfleet in Dorset, England to stay with his mother's former lover, who has the facade of a gentleman but leads a gang of swashbuckling bootleggers; the duo go on a treasure hunt.

Title: 70. Strategic Air Command
description: An ex-pilot and current baseballer is recalled into the U.S. Air Force and assumes an increasingly important role in Cold War deterrence.

Title: 71. We're No Angels
description: Three Devil's Island escapees hide out in the house of a kindly merchant and repay his kindness by helping him and his family out of several crises.

Title: 72. It Came from Beneath the Sea
description: A giant, radioactive octopus rises from the Philippine Trench to terrorize the North American Pacific Coast.

Title: 73. Queen Bee
description: When a young woman arrives at the home of her socialite cousin, she soon gets sucked into the woman's complex web of deceit.

Title: 74. Battle Cry
description: Young Marines have adventures in love and war.

Title: 75. Love Is a Many-Splendored Thing
description: A widowed Chinese-English doctor falls in love with a married American correspondent in Hong Kong during China's Communist Revolution.

Title: 76. Abbott and Costello Meet the Mummy
description: Two bumbling Americans stumble on the discovery of a lifetime when their search for a mummy leads them to a sacred medallion that holds the key to buried treasure.

Title: 77. Land of the Pharaohs
description: A captured architect designs an ingenious plan to ensure the impregnability of the tomb of a self-absorbed Pharaoh, obsessed with the security of his next life.

Title: 78. Man with the Gun
description: When a notorious tough 'town tamer' is hired by the citizenry to rid of the gunmen driving them off their land, he finds the local saloon madam to be his estranged wife.

Title: 79. Soldier of Fortune
description: After Jane Hoyt's journalist husband disappears, she arrives in Hong Kong determined to find him but instead meets shady shipping magnate Hank Lee.

Title: 80. Stranger on Horseback
description: A circuit judge in the old west attempts to bring a suspected killer to justice. The judge runs afoul of the killer's rich cattle baron father in the process.

Title: 81. Bride of the Monster
description: A mad doctor attempts to create atomic supermen.

Title: 82. Daddy Long Legs
description: A wealthy American has a chance encounter with a joyful young French woman and anonymously pays for her education. She writes letters to her mysterious benefactor, nicknaming him from the description given by some of her fellow orphans.

Title: 83. Cast a Dark Shadow
description: Edward "Teddy" Bare is a delusional psychotic with a lust for wealth, older women and murder. Having committed what he thinks is the perfect murder of his elderly wife; Teddy sets his sights on new targets when her fortune goes elsewhere.

Title: 84. Treasure of Ruby Hills
description: Unscrupulous ranchers feud among themselves for control of the valley but a newcomer owns the water rights to the sole water source, without which grazing lands are useless.

Title: 85. The Sea Chase
description: As World War II begins, German freighter Captain Karl Ehrlich tries to get his ship back to Germany through a gauntlet of Allied warships.

Title: 86. Count Three and Pray
description: A pastor with a shady past moves into a rural town just after the Civil War.

Title: 87. Blood Alley
description: His ship seized by the Chinese Communists, American Merchant Captain Tom Wilder languishes in prison but Chinese villagers help him escape to sail them to Hong-Kong.

Title: 88. It's Always Fair Weather
description: Three soldiers meet ten years after their last meeting in New York, and find out that they have little in common now.

Title: 89. Love Me or Leave Me
description: A fictionalized account of the career of jazz singer Ruth Etting and her tempestuous marriage to gangster Marty Snyder, who helped propel her to stardom.

Title: 90. Tall Man Riding
description: Larry Madden returns to Little River after several years, still vowing to avenge himself against the humiliating whipping he received at the hands of cattle baron Tucker Ordway.

Title: 91. Man Without a Star
description: Sharpshooting drifter Dempsey Rae comes back to Wyoming to work for beautiful rancher Reed Bowman. But Reed's plan to fence in her land's wide open spaces angers other ranchers and soon embroils Dempsey in a bloody range war.

Title: 92. The Colditz Story
description: Allied prisoners - British, Dutch, French and Polish - pool their resources to plan numerous escapes from the "escape-proof" German P.O.W. camp housed in a Medieval castle known as "Colditz".

Title: 93. I'll Cry Tomorrow
description: Susan Hayward stars as singer-actress Lillian Roth, whose rise to stardom was nearly destroyed by alcoholism.

Title: 94. A Kid for Two Farthings
description: In London's working-class East End, a young boy is told a story by a neighbor that a unicorn can grant wishes. The hopeful boy buys a baby goat, believing it to be a real unicorn, and sets about to prove that it can bring fortune.

Title: 95. La bella di Roma
description: Nannina is engaged to a sleazy, unruly boxer who ends up in jail after a fight with a traffic policeman.

Title: 96. New York Confidential
description: A top syndicate crime boss and his corrupt politicians make multi-million deals and order murders until the vicious pattern finally catches up to them.

Title: 97. The Court-Martial of Billy Mitchell
description: A dramatization of the American general and his court martial for publically complaining about High Command's dismissal and neglect of the aerial fighting forces.

Title: 98. Dementia
description: This film, with no dialogue at all, follows a psychotic young woman's nightmarish experiences through one skid-row night.

Title: 99. Top Gun
description: A gunslinger returns to his hometown to warn of an impending outlaw gang attack, but he's met with hatred and fear for his previous killings.

Title: 100. The Long Gray Line
description: In 1898, Irish immigrant Martin Maher is hired as a civilian employee at West Point where, during a 50-year career, he rises to the rank of NCO and instructor.

Title: 101. The Big Knife
description: Hollywood actor Charles Castle is pressured by his studio boss into a criminal cover-up to protect his valuable career.

Title: 102. Day the World Ended
description: In a post-Apocalyptic world after an atomic war seven disparate people find themselves in a protected valley in the home of a survivalist and his beautiful daughter.

Title: 103. The Cockleshell Heroes
description: During World War II, German ships are "safely" docked upriver at Bordeaux, but the British send a team of kayakers to attack them.

Title: 104. Many Rivers to Cross
description: Robert Taylor and Eleanor Parker star as a Kentucky backwoodsman and the woman who will NOT let anything interfere with her plans to marry him in this humorous romantic adventure through the American Frontier of 1798.

Title: 105. The Indian Fighter
description: A scout leading a wagon train through hostile Indian country unwittingly gets involved with a Sioux chief's daughter.

Title: 106. The Private War of Major Benson
description: As a disciplinary measure, the Army transfers a heavy-handed Major to a ROTC academy where he must shape-up cadets and improve the school's overall ratings.

Title: 107. The Wicked Go to Hell
description: Two convicts wind up in a small house by the sea where they meet a gorgeous girl whose lover they savagely kill.

Title: 108. 5 Against the House
description: Four vets attending college on the GI Bill and a cabaret singer try to rob a Reno Casino and pull off the perfect crime.

Title: 109. Conquest of Space
description: An American-led team of International astronauts leave their space station on the first mission to Mars, but the captain's religious beliefs may get in the way.

Title: 110. The Tall Men
description: Two brothers discharged from the Confederate Army join a businessman for a cattle drive from Texas to Montana where they run into raiding Jayhawkers, angry Sioux, rough terrain and bad weather.

Title: 111. Wichita
description: In 1874, after noticing the total lawlessness in Wichita, Wyatt Earp reluctantly accepts the Marshal's job and runs into the worst local troublemakers.

Title: 112. The Far Horizons
description: After purchasing Louisiana from France, the USA sends surveyors Lewis and Clark, assisted by a Shoshone guide, to chart the new territory.

Title: 113. Artists and Models
description: Rick Todd uses the dreams of his roommate Eugene as the basis for a successful comic book.

Title: 114. Kismet
description: A roguish poet is given the run of the scheming Wazir's harem while pretending to help him usurp the young caliph.

Title: 115. The Prodigal
description: A wealthy young Hebrew traveling in Damascus renounces his faith after he is seduced by an alluring pagan priestess and cheated of his fortune by the High Priest as well.

Title: 116. ¡Vaya tipos!
description: Three treasure hunters cross paths with a woman who inherited gold from her father.

Title: 117. Jin ping mei
description: The story, purportedly set revolves around Ximen Qing, a corrupt social opportunist and licentious merchant who is affluent enough to wed six wives and concubines. After Pan Jinlian covertly assassinates her husband

Title: 118. Dead by Morning
description: A crime writer and his wife go for a break to a country cottage. They receive an unexpected visitor, the bossy Miss Tulip, who needs shelter for the night. In the morning there is a dead body in the house.

Title: 119. Pearl of the South Pacific
description: Two beachcombers and Rita, a woman with a mysterious past, seek black pearls on a remote island. They discover a white man serving as high priest, whose son George catches Rita's eye. Their pearl hunt disrupts island peace.

Title: 120. The Last Frontier
description: A mountain man and his two partners scout for a military fort, where an inept colonel plans to send his unprepared garrison against Red Cloud's powerful Sioux warriors.

Title: 121. Rage at Dawn
description: A special agent from Chicago is sent out west to bring in the notorious Reno brothers.

Title: 122. Napoleon
description: Napoléon Bonaparte's life, loves and exceptional destiny from 1769 to 1821, as seen through the eyes of Talleyrand, the cynical and ironic politician who once was the Emperor of France's Minister of Foreign Affairs.

Title: 123. The Kentuckian
description: A frontiersman heads for Texas with his son and meets two women.

Title: 124. Marriage a la Mode
description: An Englishman wakes in a hotel bedroom suffering from amnesia and sets out to find his identity. He tracks down his wife but soon learns that the job she saw him leave for every morning did not exist.

Title: 125. Scandal in Sorrento
description: Returning to his hometown, a former marshal finds his house occupied by a young woman working as a fishwife.

Title: 126. The Seven Little Foys
description: After the young wife of vaudevillian Eddie Foy passes away, he incorporates their seven children into the act and takes it on the road.

Title: 127. Death of a Cyclist
description: A couple having an affair strike a bicyclist with their car and do not offer aid out of fear of their relationship being exposed.

Title: 128. Cult of the Cobra
description: American G.I.s who trespass on a Hindu ceremony are hunted down by a beautiful woman who has the power to transform herself into a cobra.

Title: 129. The Warriors
description: During the fourteenth century when the Hundred Years War between France and England is beginning the English occupation of French Aquitainia, rebel French Knights vow to oust Edward, Prince of Wales, ruler of Aquitaine.

Title: 130. Lady Godiva of Coventry
description: An 11th-century noblewoman opens her Saxon husband's eyes by riding bareback through town.

Title: 131. Women's Prison
description: A sadistic prison warden takes out her sexual frustration on her women inmates. While a caring physician tries to improve the jail's brutal atmosphere, a pair of rebellious inmates take matters into their own hands.

Title: 132. Storm Fear
description: After being wounded by a bullet, bank robber Charlie Blake seeks shelter with his gang at his brother's mountain retreat. There he rekindles his romance with his brother's wife and reconnects with the boy he believes is his son.

Title: 133. Shree 420
description: When a young man from a small town decides to make it big in a city, he faces several challenges.

Title: 134. Creature with the Atom Brain
description: An ex-Nazi mad scientist uses radio-controlled atomic-powered zombies in his quest to help an exiled American gangster return to power.

Title: 135. French Cancan
description: This comedy drama from Jean Renoir chronicles the revival of Paris' most notorious dance as it tells the story of a theater producer who turns a humble washerwoman into a star at the Moulin Rouge.

Title: 136. Break in the Circle
description: An adventurer is hired by a German millionaire to help a Polish scientist escape to the West.

Title: 137. Shotgun
description: After vengeful Ben Thompson ambushes and kills Marshal Mark Fletcher with a shotgun, Deputy Marshal Clay Hardin pursues the Thompson gang.

Title: 138. Illegal
description: After an overly aggressive district attorney unknowingly sends an innocent man to the chair, he resigns, turns to drinking, and acquires a criminal clientèle.

Title: 139. Underwater!
description: Two scuba divers find a shipwreck which may contain undiscovered treasure. However, their attempt to salvage it is threatened by scavengers.

Title: 140. How to Be Very, Very Popular
description: Two girls on the lam hide out in a college fraternity.

Title: 141. The Phenix City Story
description: An Alabama crusader's son tries to clean up sin city. A crime-busting lawyer and his father take on the corrupt forces that run a small Southern town.

Title: 142. Seven Cities of Gold
description: In 1769, a Spanish expedition to California seeks to conquer the land and discover its famed gold treasures while missionaries aim to gain new converts and establish a network of Catholic missions.

Title: 143. The Naked Street
description: A mobster (Quinn) springs a condemned murderer (Granger) because the convict got his unwed sister (Bancroft) pregnant.

Title: 144. The Beast with a Million Eyes
description: A dysfunctional family operating an isolated date farm in the California desert is threatened by the arrival of an extra-terrestrial.

Title: 145. House of Bamboo
description: Planted in a Tokyo crime syndicate, a U.S. Army Investigator attempts to probe the coinciding death of a fellow Army official.

Title: 146. Double Jeopardy
description: Lawyer Marc Hill helps clear the name of his girlfriend's father who is accused of murdering a man that was blackmailing him.

Title: 147. A Generation
description: Story of youth during the German occupation of Poland in World War II who come to adulthood through love and adversity.

Title: 148. Run for Cover
description: Mistaken for train robbers, Matt Dow and Davey Bishop are shot at by the sheriff and his posse but they are cleared and hired as lawmen.

Title: 149. The End of the Affair
description: In WW2 London, a writer falls in love with the wife of a British civil servant but both men suspect her of infidelity with yet another man.

Title: 150. La Pointe Courte
description: Follow the story of a couple who goes to a small French fishing village to try to solve the problems of their deteriorating marriage.

Title: 151. Six Bridges to Cross
description: The emotional story of a lifelong friendship between a Boston rookie cop and a young street-wise delinquent.

Title: 152. Quentin Durward
description: A Scottish knight in France to facilitate a marriage between a rich and beautiful countess and his aging uncle becomes involved in court intrigue.

Title: 153. Big House, U.S.A.
description: An FBI agent pursues an escaped kidnapper.

Title: 154. School for Tramps
description: Alberto Medina is a very famous composer and is on a field trip when his car runs out of gas and goes downhill. While looking for help, he finds the Valverdes' house and is welcome by Emilia, the mother of the family, who is known for giving shelter to tramps. The rest of the family disagrees, because the last one disappointed her. In a story of family situations, funny moments and jealousy, Alberto ends up earning everyone's respect and has a special connection with the oldest daughter, the beautiful Susana, and they fall in love.

Title: 155. Floating Clouds
description: A tragic social drama set in post war Japan about a lonely woman trying to find purpose and stability in a devastated Tokyo.

Title: 156. Three for the Show
description: A widowed singer marries her dead husband's songwriting partner which leads to trouble when her former husband turns up very much alive.

Title: 157. Unchained
description: A convict in a medium-security prison is torn between his need to finish his sentence and get back to his wife and family, and his desire to escape the confines of prison.

Title: 158. Doctor at Sea
description: Bachelor Dr. Simon Sparrow (Dirk Bogarde) goes to sea to escape his mentor's amorous daughter, but ends up in more trouble wrangling the captain, crew, and Brigitte Bardot.

Title: 159. The Tender Trap
description: Successful theater agent Charlie Reader lives a playboy's life in New York City. When his childhood friend shows up with a desire to leave his wife, the two are awestruck by each other's lifestyle.

Title: 160. A Bullet for Joey
description: In Montreal, a police inspector slowly discovers a plot to abduct a nuclear physicist, with American mobsters, foreign spies, and a blonde seductress all involved.

Title: 161. The Big Bluff
description: When a scheming fortune hunter finds his rich wife is not going to die as expected, he and his lover make other plans to get her millions.

Title: 162. A Life at Stake
description: An unemployed architect meets a married woman with a business proposition. The architect soon suspects her interest isn't just financial - and might be deadly.

Title: 163. Tight Spot
description: A female convict is whisked out of prison and into a police-guarded hotel until the district attorney can convince her to testify against the mob.

Title: 164. El 7 leguas
description: Pancho Villa's horse was named "7 leguas", Rodolfo, takes Villa's horse and tries to get away.

Title: 165. Above Us the Waves
description: The attack by British submarines on the German battleship "Tirpitz" in a Norwegian fjord during World War II.

Title: 166. The Prisoner
description: A Cardinal, a hero of resistance, endures brutal interrogation with unshakable resolve, refusing to confess his supposed treason. As his tormentor's methods fail, the interrogator finds himself unexpectedly moved by pity for indomitable.

Title: 167. Chicago Syndicate
description: A former military accountant is recruited by the FBI to infiltrate the mob in Chicago in an attempt to break open the rackets. To complicate his job, two women stand in his way, each with her own agenda.

Title: 168. Pete Kelly's Blues
description: In 1927, a Kansas City, Missouri cornet player and his band perform nightly at a seedy speakeasy until a racketeer tries to extort them in exchange for protection.

Title: 169. A Man Alone
description: A gunfighter's main hope lies in the trust of a beautiful woman who hides him out when he is wrongly suspected of a stagecoach massacre.

Title: 170. The Last Ten Days
description: The last ten days of Adolf Hitler and his Third Reich during World War 2.

Title: 171. The Virgin Queen
description: Sir Walter Raleigh (Richard Todd) overcomes court intrigue to win favor with Queen Elizabeth I (Bette Davis) in order to get financing for a proposed voyage to the New World.

Title: 172. Jupiter's Darling
description: Fabius loves his beautiful but vulnerable city, Rome, and he also loves his beautiful but invulnerable fiancée, Amytis. Fascinated by the tales she has heard about Hannibal, who is about to attack Rome, Amytis is driven by curiosity to the edge of his camp. Captured, she makes a last request of the indifferent Hannibal...that he spare the city. She offers to lead him to a hilltop where she can prove that taking the city is not worth the trouble. Hannibal goes with her, even though she has to cup her hand under his chin and float him across a river as he can't swim. Before long, Hannibal is doing more surveying of Amytis than of Rome. And Fabius finds he can defend neither his city nor his fiancée against the advances of Hannibal. Especially after he has his elephants painted bright colors because Amythis thinks gray is drab.

Title: 173. Razzia
description: Henri, a tough man from Nantes, returns to his country after working for drug dealer Liski in the US. He aims to understand the profitability of French operations and becomes master of all organization links, but faces police scrutiny.

Title: 174. Female on the Beach
description: Moving into a beach house involves Lynn Markham in mystery, danger, and romance with a beach boy of dubious motives.

Title: 175. Son of Sinbad
description: Legendary pirate and adventurer Sinbad is in single-minded pursuit of two things: beautiful women and a substance called Greek Fire--an early version of gunpowder.

Title: 176. Five Guns West
description: During the Civil War, the Confederacy pardons five criminals and sends them into Comanche territory to recover Union-seized Confederate gold and capture a Confederate turncoat.

Title: 177. The Unknown Soldier
description: The tale of a platoon of soldiers during the Continuation War. Based on Väinö Linna's book of the same name.

Title: 178. The Deep Blue Sea
description: A woman unhappy in her passionless marriage leaves her husband for a younger and more ardent lover.

Title: 179. King Dinosaur
description: A new planet moves into the Solar system and four scientists (two couples) are sent to explore planet Nova. In between romantic interludes, the cast faces an iguana masquerading as a Tyrannosaurus rex.

Title: 180. Crashout
description: The survivors of a prison break set out on an arduous journey to retrieve some loot.

Title: 181. Good Morning, Miss Dove
description: After her admission to the hospital, town-famous stern teacher Miss Dove nostalgically reminisces about her youth and about the pupils she taught over the years.

Title: 182. Seminole Uprising
description: Cavalry lieutenant ordered to capture Seminole chief Black Cat, who kidnaps colonel's daughter. Lieutenant pursues tribe, leading to violent clash where his force kills hundreds of Seminoles. Black Cat surrenders after bloody battle.

Title: 183. White Feather
description: In 1877 Wyoming, during the peace negotiations between the Cheyenne and the USA, an Indian girl falls in love with a land surveyor, causing the ire of her Cheyenne fiance.

Title: 184. One Way Ticket to Hell
description: "One Way Ticket to Hell" (aka "Teenage Devil Dolls") is a 1955 drama with Cassandra, who falls in with the wrong crowd in high school. Her home life is not great, and she turns to a group of delinquent bikers to escape.

Title: 185. Running Wild
description: A young rookie cop goes undercover to bust up an auto theft ring run by juvenile delinquents.

Title: 186. Don Camillo e l'on. Peppone
description: Bewildered, Don Camillo learns that Peppone intends to stand for parliament. Determined to thwart his ambitions, the good priest, ignoring the recommendations of the Lord, decides to campaign against him.

Title: 187. The Phantom from 10,000 Leagues
description: A seaside community is terrorized by a hideous sea monster, which has been created by experiments in atomic radiation.

Title: 188. The Littlest Outlaw
description: Little Pablito is the 10-year-old son of a cruel horse trainer who's responsible for training a Mexican general's horse to jump for the grand race. The trainer's methods cause the horse to become afraid of jumping and the general orders the animal's death. Pablito runs away with the horse, becoming a fugitive. He travels throughout Mexico encountering several fugitives and a priest who tries to help.

Title: 189. The King's Thief
description: An ex-soldier turned highwayman uncovers a plot to take control of England from King Charles II.

Title: 190. The Gun That Won the West
description: In the late 1860s, Colonel Carrington and his command are assigned the job of constructing a chain of forts in the Sioux Indian territory - of Wyoming. Carrington recruits former cavalry scouts Jim Bridger and "Dakota Jack" Gaines to lead the project. Bridger and Gaines are friendly with Sioux Chief Red Cloud, and they feel a peace treaty with the Indians can be made. If an Indian war breaks out, the cavalry is depending on getting a new type of Springfield rifle. Bridger, Gaines and Gaines wife, Maxine, arrive at the fort for the conference. Gaines, in a drunken fit, tries to intimidate the Indians into signing a treaty. Chief Red Cloud threatens war if his territory is invaded by any troops building forts.

Title: 191. The Second Greatest Sex
description: In 1880, Osawkie, Kansas is feuding with rival town Mandaroon over which will be county seat, keeping the town's men away from home most of the time. The last straw is when Matt Davis feels compelled to go on a new foray on his wedding night; his bride Liza (just call her Lysistrata) takes teacher Cassie's advice and organizes a marital strike to make the men-folk stop their nonsense.

Title: 192. Trial
description: Courtroom drama set in 1947 and underlying post-WW2 acute problems facing the USA such as stormy race relations and the growing threat of local communism.

Title: 193. Hi-Jack Highway
description: After a spending the night with his girlfriend, trucker Jean encounters a dead body on the road home. He reports the incident to the police who suspect that Jean was responsible for the death.

Title: 194. Fort Yuma
description: A disgruntled settler kills an Apache chief at Fort Yuma, and the fort's commander knows that the chief's son, Manga Colorado, will seek revenge and go on the warpath.

Title: 195. Girl on the Third Floor
description: A Parisian reporter tries to exonerate a fugitive neighbor of charges he murdered his wife.

Title: 196. School for Love
description: At the Conservatory of Vienna the students only have eyes for their beautiful singing teacher, tenor Eric Walter.

Title: 197. A Man Called Peter
description: The rise of Peter Marshall, from modest Scottish upbringing, to New York seminary, time in Atlanta churches, his marriage, appointment as chaplain of the US Senate, and early death at 46. Based on real events.

Title: 198. Lucy Gallant
description: The success story of a dressmaker who comes to run a group of fashion shops at the expense of her love life.

Title: 199. Foxfire
description: In Arizona, during the 1950s, privileged white girl Amanda Lawrence marries half-Apache mining engineer Jonathan Dartland who dreams of finding gold in an old abandoned Apache mine.

Title: 200. The Night My Number Came Up
description: On a routine flight from Hong Kong to Japan, a British military transport aircraft's fate may or may not depend on a prophetic nightmare.

Title: 201. Tennessee's Partner
description: In a California mining town, a gold miner, a saloon gambler and a cat house madam strike an odd alliance revolving around a gold mine claim.

Title: 202. Postmark for Danger
description: A woman's painted portrait and a post card with a sketch of a woman's hand holding a Chianti bottle are the main clues used by the Scotland Yard to solve a string of murders connected to a diamond-smuggling ring.

Title: 203. Stella
description: Caught up in an all-consuming whirlwind romance with a local heartthrob, Stella, a fiercely proud Rebetiko diva, resists surrender. But everything points to a tragic ending. And in the aftermath of passion, there can be no winners.

Title: 204. You're Never Too Young
description: When an aspiring barber becomes inadvertently involved in the theft of a valuable diamond, necessity forces him to masquerade as a 12 year-old child - with humorous consequences.

Title: 205. Abbott and Costello Meet the Keystone Kops
description: Harry and Willie buy the Edison Movie Studio in the year 1912 from Joseph Gorman, a confidence man. They follow Gorman to Hollywood where, as stunt men, they find him directing movies as Sergei Trumanoff and stealing the studio payroll.

Title: 206. La mujer desnuda
description: A serious radio journalist becomes a successful showgirl.

Title: 207. Untamed
description: In 1847, the Irish potato famine forces Katie O'Neill and her husband to emigrate to a troubled South Africa where Katie runs into an old flame.

Title: 208. The Night Holds Terror
description: A group of convicted felons take over a suburban house to escape the ongoing police manhunt, turning the life of the family living there into a nightmare.

Title: 209. Shack Out on 101
description: An isolated diner on California's 101 highway provides the backdrop of the story involving nuclear secrets, foreign spies and federal agents.

Title: 210. The Spoilers
description: In 1899 Alaska, miners have to protect themselves from a phony legal team trying to steal their gold claims.

Title: 211. Lady Chatterley's Lover
description: Adaptation of D.H. Lawrence's classic risqué novel about an aristocratic wife who has a passionate affair with her gamekeeper.

Title: 212. Shadow of Fear
description: A college student returns home to attend her father's funeral and begins to suspect her stepmother of foul play.

Title: 213. Interrupted Melody
description: This movie chronicles Australian-born opera star Marjorie Lawrence's success, her battle with polio, and her eventual career comeback.

Title: 214. Gentlemen Marry Brunettes
description: Two Broadway showgirls who are also sisters are sick and tired of New York, and sick and tired of getting nowhere. They decide to quit Broadway and travel to Paris to try their luck and talent there.

Title: 215. Teaserama
description: A collection of numerous burlesque acts from the 1950s, including strippers, and cult character Betty Page introducing the acts.

Title: 216. The Miller's Beautiful Wife
description: Luca runs a mill and is married to Carmela, a beautiful wife. But his wife's beauty catches the eye of Don Teofilo the Governor.

Title: 217. Chief Crazy Horse
description: This biography of the famous Lakota Sioux war chief is told entirely from the Indian viewpoint.

Title: 218. The Last Command
description: Moderate Jim Bowie leads rebellious Texicans--and Davy Crockett--in a last-ditch stand against his old friend, Santa Ana.

Title: 219. The Scarlet Coat
description: During the Revolutionary War, American Major John Bolton feigns desertion in order to uncover a British plot to seize the stronghold of West Point.

Title: 220. Seven Angry Men
description: Rise, fall and execution of John Brown, fanatic abolitionist.

Title: 221. A Prize of Gold
description: World War II sergeant Joe Lawrence falls for refugee aiming to relocate German orphans. He conspires with comrades to fund relocation through heist. Plot follows daring robbery plan and blossoming romance amidst wartime challenges.

Title: 222. Hell's Island
description: Down-on-his-luck Mike Cormack is hired to fly to a Caribbean island to retrieve a missing ruby. On the island, possibly involved with the ruby's disappearance, is his ex-girlfriend.

Title: 223. Hell on Frisco Bay
description: After 5 years in prison, ex-cop Steve Rollins is paroled and searches for the San Francisco mobsters who framed him for manslaughter.

Title: 224. Death Tide
description: Pirates take over a ship with a cargo of diamonds.

Title: 225. Escape to Burma
description: A fugitive in British Burma hides on a teak plantation, thanks to a mutual attraction with owner Gwen Moore.

Title: 226. Ma and Pa Kettle at Waikiki
description: Ma, Pa, and their daughter Rosie go off to Hawai'i to answer ailing Cousin Rodney's call for help running his pineapple farm while he recovers. Pa soon causes a major explosion and gets himself kidnapped.

Title: 227. The Crooked Web
description: Government agent tries to trick a suspect into returning to Germany, the scene of his crimes.

Title: 228. Sins of Casanova
description: 1760 Spain provides the setting for Giacomo Casanova's romantic escapades, every woman he encounters unable to resist his disarming charm, be they single, engaged, or even married.

Title: 229. Cell 2455, Death Row
description: A Death Row prisoner applies legal knowledge gained behind bars to battle for his own survival. True story.

Title: 230. Forever a Woman
description: Fumiko, mother of two, divorces her unfaithful husband and gets positive feedback as a fledgling poet when she develops breast cancer which spreads to her lungs. An admiring journalist befriends her and helps further her career.

Title: 231. I Am a Camera
description: In Weimar-era Berlin, an aspiring writer strikes up a friendship with a vivacious, penniless singer.

Title: 232. Oh... Rosalinda!!
description: Pseudonym Dr. Falke pursues his wife through disguises and deceptions in postwar Vienna, an operetta adaptation involving occupying powers' protagonists, not a staged production but a cinematic reimagining.

Title: 233. Mr. & Mrs. '55
description: A young woman must be married to claim her inheritance; her misandrist aunt uses the newly-passed 1955 divorce bill to find her a temporary husband.

Title: 234. The Sign of Venus
description: Agnese has many men who woo her and lives with her cousin Cesira Franca Valeri, who has the opposite problem with men and wishes she would also have men woo her.

Title: 235. Teen-Age Crime Wave
description: A delinquent girl involves an innocent friend in an armed robbery followed by a jail-break and hostage-taking with her equally delinquent boyfriend.

Title: 236. Le crâneur
description: A singer tries to rescue a man drawn into the drug trade.

Title: 237. The Looters
description: An expert mountain climber and his partner find a plane wreck in the Rockies, but the partner conspires with one of the plane's survivors to stop at nothing to steal a large amount of cash found on board.

Title: 238. No Man's Woman
description: The police investigates five possible suspects in the murder of a greedy and scheming woman who wronged them.

Title: 239. Bloody Spear at Mount Fuji
description: A samurai travels to Edo with his two servants. On their way, they meet many people and encounter great injustice.

Title: 240. The Marauders
description: An innocent squatter in Arizona Territory, Jeff Richards, builds a home in a box canyon, and then has to battle to survive as Dan Duryea and his small army of gunfighters try to evict him.

Title: 241. Yôkihi
description: In 8th Century China, a widowed emperor devotes his life to composing music. When he meets and falls in love with a beautiful young woman, a tale of political intrigue and rival dynasties is set in motion, with tragic consequences.

Title: 242. The Counterfeit Coin
description: Pivoting around a shiny counterfeit gold sovereign freshly milled from the clandestine workshop of an otherwise honest goldsmith, four brief vignettes of human imperfection; seduction; fate; desire, and devotion inextricably interweave.

Title: 243. Female Jungle
description: Several persons, including an off duty policeman and a weird rich guy, are suspects in the murder of a beautiful actress.

Title: 244. Alias John Preston
description: John Preston meets Sally who agrees to marry him. Then, Preston begins to have dreams about Sylvia, a woman from his past, who comes to Deanbridge to blackmail him. In his dream, Preston strangles. He seeks help from Doctor Walton.

Title: 245. The Grand Maneuver
description: A French lieutenant makes a bet that he can seduce any woman in town in the two weeks before his regiment leaves for maneuvers, but his chosen target (a Parisian divorcée) isn't like other girls he's known.

Title: 246. Contraband Spain
description: Government agent Richard Greene is sent to the French-Spanish border to round up smugglers and counterfeiters after his brother is murdered. He is helped by singer Anouk Aimée with whom he falls in love.

Title: 247. The Americano
description: An American working on a ranch in the Amazon comes up against a gang of Brazilian bandits.

Title: 248. Fun at St Fanny's
description: 25 year old Cardew is still at school, run by a large headmaster Who lives and bets off the income that comes from Cardew s uncle will. Of course, the headmaster and the matron don't let Cardew leave school.

Title: 249. The Moon Has Risen
description: Mokichi is the widowed father of three daughters, with whom he lives on the premises of a temple since the war. All three daughters become involved in some sort of complicated relationships.

Title: 250. The Racers
description: Follows the professional and personal life of race car driver Gino Borgesa (Douglas), as he struggles on the track and in his love life.

Title: 251. At Gunpoint
description: The peace-loving owner of a general store, who became a town hero after he luckily killed the leader of a gang of bank robbers, is deserted by the townspeople who fear the threatened return of the vengeful bandits.

Title: 252. The Rats
description: When penniless Pauline's child is born she gives it to Anna who will raise the baby as her own. Soon Pauline has second thoughts, but mistakenly kidnaps another baby to take with her. Still Anna instructs her bother Bruno to kill Pauline.

Title: 253. Strange Lady in Town
description: Greer Garson plays a female doctor who plans to introduce modern techniques of medicine to old Santa Fe in 1880, but is opposed by an established doctor.

Title: 254. Captain Lightfoot
description: A pair of Irish rebels have swashbuckling adventures in 1815.

Title: 255. The McConnell Story
description: A Korean War fighter pilot hero returns home to test fly the new Sabre jets despite his wife's uneasiness regarding his job.

Title: 256. The Devil's General
description: During WW2, German general Harry Harras is a test pilot and chief engineer for the Luftwaffe but his contempt for the Nazis and sabotage at the aircraft plant land him in hot water with the Gestapo.

Title: 257. Where There's a Will
description: A Cockney family. (3 sisters, a brother-in-law and a niece) inherit a ramshackle Devon farm. The rest of the family doesn't want to leave London, but one of the male relatives insists and off they go to face the unknown.

Title: 258. Storm Over the Nile
description: A British officer resigns his commission on the eve of his regiment's departure for war in Sudan. Accused of cowardice by his friends and the woman he loves, he sets out to prove his courage to them. A remake of "The Four Feathers" (1939).

Title: 259. Wee Geordie
description: Geordie is a very small boy who feels that the girl he loves is ignoring him because of his size. He decides to take a correspondence course in body-building. At 21, Geordie becomes one of the tallest and strongest men in Scotland.

Title: 260. King's Rhapsody
description: Richard, son of the King of Laurentia, who has been living in Monte Carlo with Martha Karrillos for several years because his parents refused to accept this unroyal affair, is called to assume his duties after his father's death. He is expected to marry the princess of an allied country and produce with her an heir to the throne. Will he give up his true love?

Title: 261. Santa Fe Passage
description: A disgraced Indian scout and his partner are hired to escort a wagon-load of guns through Indian territory.

Title: 262. ...Y mañana serán mujeres
description: A teacher accepts the invitation of several families to enjoy the summer at a ranch with her students.

Title: 263. The Naked Dawn
description: In Mexico, at the dawn of the automobile, modern bandit Santiago burglarizes train freight cars and falls in love with a poor farmer's wife.

Title: 264. Kiss of Fire
description: In 1700, a Spanish princess travels from New Mexico to California with ruthless outlaw El Tigre as guide.

Title: 265. Duel on the Mississippi
description: In 1820 Louisiana, river pirates tangle with plantation owners while gambling ship pirate queen Lili Scarlet falls in love with planter André Tulane to the dismay of rival Hugo Marat, leader of the river pirates.

Title: 266. Drop the Curtain
description: A window washer (Mario Moreno "Cantinflas") is accused of stealing jewels from a famous actress, but is given 30 days to solve the crime.

Title: 267. Schneewittchen und die sieben Zwerge
description: Snow White's mother, the Queen dies when she is born. Her father, the King, remarries a beautiful but vain lady. The new Queen has a magic mirror that she asks every day, who is the fairest one of all? When it answers Snow White, the Queen is furious. Will handsome Prince Charming and the Seven Dwarfs be able to save Snow White from the wicked Queen's wrath?

Title: 268. Murder Is My Beat
description: A police detective helps a singer heading to prison for the murder of a man she claims is still alive.

Title: 269. Cupido pierde a Paquita
description: Follow up to Los paquetes de Paquita. Paquita still works as a maid who aspires one day to become "the lady of the house". But this time, contrary to expectations, love will keep eluding her.

Title: 270. Ciske de Rat
description: Popular Dutch story of a troubled boy who doesn't get along with his mother while his sailor father is gone, and whose only help saving him from a career of crime is a schoolteacher.

Title: 271. Die Mädels vom Immenhof
description: In 1954, after their flight from East Prussia following WWII, orphaned sister Angela, Barbara (Dick), and Brigitte (Dalli) have settled with their Oma (Grandmother) Jantzen near Eutin in Schleswig-Holstein. The Jantzens have owned the 18th-century manor horse "Immenhof" for over 100 years, breeding and selling ponies. Jochen von Roth has only recently returned from POW camp and is now trying to establish a stud farm in the old forester's house about 5 kilometers from the manor house. Both Oma Jantzen and von Roth are struggling with finances. Debt might force Oma Jantzen to face auctioning off her possessions. Into this situation arrives Ethelbert, the sisters' posh big-city cousin, making a fool of himself in his red-and-white riding gear, falling off ponies and into traps, but Dick feels drawn to him. Romance also blossoms between Jochen von Roth and Angela. Helped along by a thunderstorm and a horse-buyer's cash, everything resolves happily, with Jochen proposing to Angela and Ethelbert promising to write often.

Title: 272. Robbers' Roost
description: Jim Tex Wall is searching for three men who killed his wife and stole his horses and finds them working for a gang of cattle rustlers engaged in a turf war with a rival gang of outlaws.

Title: 273. City of Shadows
description: 12-year-old Danny meets up with Big Tim. a hoodlum wannabe running slot machines. 10 years later, Big Tim is a mob kingpin and Danny is his consiglieri, although still in law school-but first love interferes with his budding mob career.

Title: 274. Track the Man Down
description: A newspaper reporter finds himself drawn into the aftermath of a racetrack robbery.

Title: 275. Drei Männer im Schnee
description: A rich man wins a vacation at a hotel but takes it in the disguise of a poor man under the supervision of his butler. The hotel manager gets tipped off about the plot, but misidentifies a money-less doctor as the eccentric.

Title: 276. Nana
description: The amorous career of a courtesan and how she met her death at the hands of a rejected lover.

Title: 277. Tarzan's Hidden Jungle
description: Tarzan fights White poachers who trespass on his domain and on lands belonging to the native Sukulu tribe.

Title: 278. The Magnificent Matador
description: In Mexico City, rich American Karen Harrison falls in love with famous bullfighter Luis Santos who hides a personal secret regarding his young protégé Rafael Reyes.

Title: 279. The View from Pompey's Head
description: Anson Page, a lawyer with Southern roots leaves New York, his wife and his kids for Georgia. His assignment is to investigate the case of Garvin Wales, a famous writer, now nearly blind and embittered, whose royalties have apparently never reached him. Back in his native South, Page finds himself immediately exposed to what he had fled - racial and class prejudices. But he also meets his former love, Dinah, now married to go-getter uncouth businessman Mickey Higgins. Will he find out whatever happened to 2,000 dollars in rights Wales did not cash? Will Dinah and Anson renew their love story?

Title: 280. Smoke Signal
description: A suspected cavalry deserter proves to be resourceful in helping the surviving members of a fort by fleeing from Indians along a dangerous river.

Title: 281. Panther Girl of the Kongo
description: Jean Evans of an international wildlife foundation has made herself at home in Africa as the elephant-riding, vine-swinging, miniskirted 'Panther Girl.' On safari to film animals, Jean encounters something really wild; a giant crayfish monster (created by greedy scientist Morgan who, with his henchmen, hopes to scare everyone out of the district, then secretly mine diamonds). Jungle perils aplenty stand between Jean (an active, competent heroine) and her hunter friend Larry and their goal of tracing the 'claw monster' to its source.

Title: 282. Jedda the Uncivilized
description: Set in Australia's outback, young Aboriginal girl Jedda finds herself torn between her indigenous roots and the prejudiced white society, unable to fully embrace either culture.

Title: 283. The Rains of Ranchipur
description: Despite marital problems, English Lord Albert Esketh and his rich American socialite wife Lady Edwina Esketh travel to India to buy a prize horse from the ruler of Ranchipur.

Title: 284. PT Raiders
description: A trio of ex-servicemen begin smuggling innocuous black market items into post-war Britain, but through greed they graduate to more sinister cargo.

Title: 285. One Desire
description: In early 1900s, an Oklahoma gambler-casino dealer teams up with a saloon dancer and together they seek a new life in a Colorado mining town where their relationship and respectability are tested.

Title: 286. Half Human
description: A yeti terrorizes people on top of Mount Fuji.

Title: 287. The Woman in the Painting
description: Mario and the new kid Franco gradually become the best of friends, but their friendship is tested when one of them wins a competition.

Title: 288. They Can't Hang Me
description: A senior civil servant is condemned to hang for murder but he claims to have top secret security information...

Title: 289. Prince of Players
description: A tragic and sentimental story that depicts the early career of the 19th century American actor, Edwin Booth with some mention of the events leading to the assassination of President Lincoln by Edwin's brother, John Wilkes Booth. In the film, Edwin's days in the spotlight dwindle shortly after his brother is caught and killed for assassinating Lincoln.

Title: 290. Taira Clan Saga
description: After his father is not rewarded for his military achievements, Taira Kiyomori rebels against the court and the monks who rule the country. He also falls in love with Tokiko and discovers unsettling revelations about his parentage.

Title: 291. Simon and Laura
description: In the 1950s days of only BBC television, a wet-behind-the-ears producer has the idea of basing a family drama series on a real-life happily married actor couple. Unfortunately, he chooses the Fosters, who agree to do the show because they need the money. Actors they might be -- but happily married they most surely are not.

Title: 292. The Heart
description: At the end of the Meiji era a young student befriends an older man who, as a proof of trust but also as a kind of exorcism, entrusts him with his secret, a story about jealousy, betrayal, shame, and guilt.

Title: 293. The Return of Jack Slade
description: Jack Slade, son of a lawman, is hired by Pinkerton detective Joseph Ryan to help outlaws and train robbers. After Texas Rose steals his gun, Slade joins the gang and, with Ryan's help, sets a trap for the gang.

Title: 295. New Orleans Uncensored
description: A Navy veteran purchases a government surplus vessel and becomes involved in the capture of waterfront racketeers.

Title: 296. Fingerman
description: An ex-con goes undercover for the government to "finger" the crime boss who made his sister a drug addict.

Title: 297. Hill 24 Doesn't Answer
description: In 1948, four Israeli soldiers recount the events that led them to take up arms while preparing for a final mission in the hours leading up to a truce.

Title: 298. Rumpelstiltskin
description: A goblin helps a miller's daughter spin straw into gold, asking in return for her first child, in this amusing 'teaching play' about greed, envy and helpfulness.

Title: 299. To Paris with Love
description: A middle-aged widower takes his son on a trip to Paris, where they try to find wives for each other.

Title: 300. Out of the Clouds
description: A busy day at London Airport. Follow the lives and loves of the crew and passengers.

Title: 301. Jump Into Hell
description: Four young French Army officers volunteer to join the Foreign Legion to fight in Dien Bien Phu (Vietnam) in 1954.

Title: 302. La gaviota
description: A woman from a seaside fishing town must choose between a local fisherman and a vacationing doctor.

Title: 303. The Square Jungle
description: A grocery store clerk turns prizefighter to win prize money to bail his drunken father out of jail.

Title: 304. Frou-Frou
description: Four regulars at Maxim's restaurant in Paris try to turn a flower seller into a singer.

Title: 305. Beautiful But Dangerous
description: Rome, 1905. Lina, a music hall singer, has fallen in love with Sergei, a Russian prince. Maestro Doria, who gives her voice lessons and who hopes to make her his mistress, takes her to Paris where she becomes the star of the "Folies-Plastiques". Sergei finds Lina back in the French capital and, as a play and game, makes her his mistress. When she understands the truth Lina runs away with tenor Silvani. Mad with jealousy, Doria kills Silvani and the young singer who thinks Sergei is responsible for Silvani's death, decides to devote her life to her career. Going from success to success, Lina arrives one day in Saint Petersburg where she is to sing before the Tsar. There she meets Sergei again...

Title: 306. Apache Woman
description: A government agent is sent to a western town to investigate attacks that the townspeople say are being commited by rampaging Apaches. The agent, however, suspects that different forces may be committing these crimes.

Title: 307. Target Zero
description: Set during the Korean War, a unit of American soldiers, together with three British tank crew, find themselves trapped behind enemy lines.

Title: 308. Stolen Assignment
description: A journalist harasses his editor-in-chief to entrust him with a more substantial mission. When an artist's wealthy wife is murdered, the two men try to help a detective solve the case.

Title: 309. The Silver Star
description: A frontier marshal doubts his own courage when three gunmen threaten his town.

Title: 310. Un eroe dei nostri tempi
description: Alberto Menichetti lives with an aunt and an old housekeeper, Clotilde; he has a job in a firm and his boss is Mrs. De Ritis, a widow whose husband was killed during a wild boar hunt. She likes him but Alberto likes Marcella; she is under age and he is awaiting her birthday to declare his love. His greater traits are to be fearful of everything and to be selfish. This nature will get him into trouble.

Title: 311. The Hussars
description: This satire on militarism is set during the period when the revolutionary French, under their new leader Napoleon.,marched into Italy, and deals with the relationship between the troops and the local Italians.

Title: 312. Untamed Mistress
description: Two men search the jungle for a woman who has been captured by a tribe of murderous gorillas. When they finally find her, they must fight off attacks by the gorillas, who are determined to keep her.

Title: 313. The Light Across the Street
description: Story in flashback of an injured restaurant owner told to avoid straining himself with his wife, and the new young garage manager across the street who desires her. Considered the first film to showcase Bardot's natural sensuality.

Title: 314. Marianne of My Youth
description: A young man in a Bavarian boarding school falls in love with a mysterious girl.

Title: 315. The Gadfly
description: Against the background of Italian Patriots struggle for independence of his homeland, is three people by the tragic destiny of stops. Arthur who has evolved in the revolutionary, cardinal Montanelli and his love Gemma.

Title: 316. The Treasure of Pancho Villa
description: In 1915, an American adventurer joins the supporters of Mexican revolutionary Pancho Villa.

Title: 317. Dvenadtsataya noch
description: Based on Shakespeare's play Twelfth Night, or What You Will.

Title: 318. Jungle Moon Men
description: Priestess Oma is forever young in this Jungle Jim knockoff of "She" or the La of Opar stories from "Tarzan". The Jungle Jim type is played by Weissmuller using his own name.

Title: 319. Orgullo
description: The story of rivalry between the Mendozas and the Alzagas recommences as the two heirs fall in love.

Title: 320. Marguerite de la nuit
description: Based on novel by Pierre Dumarchais. The story of the aging pedant who sells his soul to Satan in exchange for youth and knowledge.

Title: 321. Simba
description: A European family in East Africa finds itself caught up in an uprising by local black Africans against their white colonial masters. Based on the Mau-Mau rebellion in Kenya in the early 1950s.

Title: 322. Caroline and the Rebels
description: A French officer and his sister develop an inappropriate attraction, leading to comical misadventures and an unexpected twist that brings them closer despite their forbidden desire.

Title: 323. Heidi and Peter
description: Heidi lives with her grandfather in the Swiss Alps in the summer, and she and Peter play and tend the goats. In the winter, she stays with Peter's mother, and she and Peter attend school. One day a letter arrives from Heidi's friend Klara Sesemann, an ill youngster who spends most of her time in wheelchair, stating that she is coming to visit. The teacher has been having trouble getting Peter to study, and Heidi's grandfather decides to pose as Santa Claus and scare him into it. This is successful, and Heidi helps Peter learn to read. they attend school. The arrival of summer also brings Klara, with her grandmother and her prim governess Rottenmeyer. Heidi's grandfather suggests that Frau Sesemann stay with him and Heidi, while Rottermeyer stays in the village to visit and keep an eye on Klara. Peter is resentful and destroys Klara's wheelchair. Heidi's grandfather is secretly pleased, as he feels that Klara doesn't really need it. Calamity strikes when a storm causes the brook to overflow, flooding the village and wrecking many houses. Klara pitches in to help and forgets about her illness, emerging a healthy and happy girl. Her father is overjoyed and organizes a festival in a nearby town to help the stricken village.

Title: 324. The Man from Bitter Ridge
description: In Tomahawk, the crooked Jackman brothers control the town, Sheriff Dunham is up for re-election, the sheep growers are banned in town and a stagecoach line undercover investigator arrives to catch the gang that regularly robs the stages.

Title: 325. Escapade
description: A peace activist neglects his family while pursuing his causes. As his wife considers leaving, they learn their sons face expulsion for fighting. When they visit the school, the boys are missing.

Title: 326. Man of the Moment
description: Civil Servant Norman becomes the favourite of the rulers of a South Seas island that the British have an interest in.

Title: 327. La vedova X
description: The young race car driver Vittorio is undecided whether to marry the rich widow Diana or the innocent young girl Adriana. Vittorio's indecision brings suffering to Diana and Adriana until he is killed in an automobile accident.

Title: 328. The Purple Mask
description: In 1803 France, Napoleon Bonaparte (Robert Cornthwaite) orders the capture of notorious highwayman "Purple Mask" (Tony Curtis), who routinely rescues imprisoned nobles and harasses the Revolutionary officials.

Title: 329. Ludwig II: Glanz und Ende eines Königs
description: King Ludwig II of Bavaria is frustrated, having to accept parliament's will to join Bismarck, rather he his cultured Habsburg friends, in wars. His love-life being as fruitless, he seeks comfort in art. But building fairytale castles and an even grander opera for his musical idol Wagner proves so expensive, his cabinet ends up resorting to formally challenging his mental health, plausible as his beloved brother Otto contracted schizophrenia earlier. Tragedy now lurks in Ludwig's prison-castle.

Title: 330. Munimji
description: Roopa lives a wealthy lifestyle with her widowed dad, Captain Suresh, and brother, Shekhar. After she returns from abroad, she is told that she must now prepare to get married to her betrothed, Ratan, who is the son of a close friend of Suresh. Everything changes suddenly when Roopa meets with a handsome young man, Raj, and both fall in love with each other. Raj then breaks her heart when he tells her that his mother, Malti, who works as a maidservant in Suresh's household, has always favored Ratan over him, has made him promise to step out of Ratan's way. Before she could find out whey Malti prefers Ratan over Raj, a bandit, Kala Ghoda, who has been terrorizing the region asks Suresh to pay up Rs.50,000/-. The Police lay a trap for this extortionist and capture him red-handed - and he turns out to be none other than Suresh's Munim. Surprises are in store for everyone when they find out that Munim is none other than Raj, who has been masquerading as the Munim for many years, and may also have embezzled another Rs.50,000/-.

Title: 331. The Eternal Sea
description: Rear Adm. John M. Hoskins (Sterling Hayden) fights to stay on after losing a leg on an aircraft carrier in World War II.

Title: 332. The Vanishing American
description: A white woman who inherits land in New Mexico makes an alliance with the local Navajos against greedy land grabbers and crooked white traders.

Title: 333. Joe MacBeth
description: Lily Macbeth manipulates her husband Joe to assassinate a crime boss and take over his syndicate. Joe becomes paranoid, murders Lennie's father and wife. Betrayals and guilt consume him, leading to his ultimate downfall.

Title: 334. The Devil from Mill Mountain
description: The evil miller destroys the windmill farm so that the farmers will have no choice but to have their grain ground at his mill. But young Anne is onto him. So the miller has her taken away to a castle.

Title: 335. Para siempre
description: Un hombre, molesto por la intromisión de su esposa en el negocio familiar, viaja a España, donde se relaciona con otra mujer.

Title: 336. Diamond Machine
description: A group of bandits conspire to kidnap a scientist who can help them manufacture diamonds.Unbeknownst to them , the FBI is already on their case.

Title: 337. An Alligator Named Daisy
description: An Englishman is left with an abandoned, very tame, and domesticated pet alligator, who helps him develop a bond with a young Irishwoman. Plans to get rid of the animal cause mayhem and produce a surprising outcome for all.

Title: 338. The Case of Poisons
description: Madame de Montespan, the Maîtresse-en-titre of Louis XIV, has been in disgrace since the King set eyes on a younger beauty, Marie-Angélique Scorailles. Having had enough of the situation, the rejected mistress decides to visit La Voisin, a woman known as a fortune teller, a doctor, a midwife and who is also said to arrange black masses and sell poisons. Some time later Marie-Angélique, now Duchess of Fontanges, dies mysteriously aged only twenty...

Title: 339. Ain't Misbehavin'
description: A rowdy young girl crashes high society when a wealthy older man falls for her.

Title: 340. The Atomic Man
description: A scientist is found floating with bullet and a radiation halo around his body. The radioactivity has put him seven-and-a-half seconds ahead of us in time. He teams up with a reporter to stop his double from destroying his experiments.

Title: 341. She Was Like a Wild Chrysanthemum
description: An old man, being rowed along a river, sees a field of daisies and thinks back to when he was fifteen. He recalls his time with, and away from, the girl cousin he grew up with and would have married, except the family and other pressures got in the way.

Title: 342. The Shrike
description: A successful theatrical director is driven to failure by the machinations of his vengeful wife. Eventually, he lands in a mental hospital where both his wife and his new love, a young actress named Charlotte, are waiting to see him.

Title: 343. Value for Money
description: A wealthy young man from Yorkshire visits a London nightclub and meets a performer. She decides to take him for every penny he is worth, and he lets her.

Title: 344. The Flaw
description: A professional race car driver marries a wealthy woman for her money, and then plans to murder her.

Title: 345. A Time to Kill
description: In the grounds of a dark, deserted mansion, a blackmailer collects money from his victim. Meanwhile, Peter (John Horsley, THE FALL AND RISE OF REGINALD PERRIN), chemist and philanderer, realises that the drinks of himself and his mistress, Madeline, have been poisoned. He phones Dr. Cole but Madeline dies. But when Mrs. Cole is brutally murdered and Peter is the chief suspect, Peter's snubbed fiancée takes up the case.

Title: 346. The Little Rebels
description: The world of juvenile delinquents seen through the eyes of a judge.

Title: 347. As Long as They're Happy
description: Stockbroker John's daughter Pat tricks US crooner Bobby into visiting her family at their suburban Wimbledon home. Her two sisters and their oddball husbands also challenge Dad to overcome his stuffy prejudices, and boy, does he change.

Title: 348. Stock Car
description: Katie attempts to save her fathers failing garage after he is killed during a stock car race, but one of the creditors is determined to take the garage.

Title: 349. It's a Dog's Life
description: A bull terrier tells his life story, from the streets of the Bowery to a life of luxury.

Title: 350. House No. 44
description: Ashok is a petty thief working under a notorious gangster named Sunder. When Ashok comes across a dead body of a watchman, he reports this matter to the police, much to the anger of some of Sunder's men. Ashok then meets Nimmo, and both fall in love with each other. Nimmo convinces Ashok to give up this life of crime, and begin anew. Ashok agrees, and then when he has not eaten for two or three days, he realizes that it is not that easy to be a honest man. And neither will his former associates let him live very long, nor will they trust their secrets with him as long as he is alive.

Title: 351. Kentucky Rifle
description: While the wagon train forges ahead, a few people stay behind to repair a disabled rifle-filled wagon but they have to contend with one another's ego and with aggressive Comanches who demand the rifles as payment for safe passage.

Title: 352. That Lady
description: In 1570, widowed Princess Ana de Mendoza becomes the love object of a deadly rivalry between her cousin Don Inigo, King Philip II of Spain and his secretary of state Antonio Perez.

Title: 353. Lo scapolo
description: Paolo Anselmi is a happy single man. He lives in an apartment with a friend but must leave when his friend marries. He then goes to a boarding house where he flirts with a girl but leaves her.

Title: 354. What a Lovely Cha Cha Cha
description: A Mexican film by Gilberto Martinez Solares. That's about it.

Title: 355. The Road to Denver
description: Two fugitive Texan brothers at odds with one another flee to Colorado where they take jobs with rival bosses.

Title: 356. Sudden Danger
description: A woman who heads a sportswear manufacturing company is found dead. Although it is ruled a suicide, the police detective in charge believes she was murdered, and his subsequent investigation begins to focus on the woman's son, who was blinded by her in an accident several years before.

Title: 357. Bedevilled
description: A seminary student helps a singer sought by Paris police.

Title: 358. Sleeping Beauty
description: A fairy tale classic that is faithful to the fairy tale tradition, full of mystical wonder and fantastic moments and characters.

Title: 359. Sincerely Yours
description: Tony Warrin has it all: a popular pianist who plays any style, he has money, great clothes, a penthouse overlooking Central Park, a rich blond fiancée, a loyal brunette secretary secretly in love with him, and a date at Carnegie Hall. On concert night, disease deafens him. While medical science works on a cure, he must find other ventures. He learns lip reading and, using high-powered binoculars, eavesdrops on conversations in the park. When he finds people in need, he plays God, interceding with help. Meanwhile, his fiancée is falling in love with another man, his secretary quits, and his doctors give him new hope. Carnegie Hall and true love may be within reach.

Title: 360. Half Human
description: Japanese villagers worship a monster and its son who live in an island cave. Some circus people hear about them, go to the island to capture the monster, and wind up shooting its son. Then the trouble starts.

Title: 361. Laterna, ftoheia kai filotimo
description: Instead of success in the Greek province, two poor portable barrel piano players stumble upon an affluent but desperate runaway girl, intent on escaping a much-despised arranged marriage. Will they forsake their beliefs for money's sake?

Title: 362. Timberjack
description: In the late 1800s Montana, two competing logging operators clash over ownership of a logging railroad, land and timber clear-cutting rights.

Title: 363. The White Poodle
