description: An old-timer, his musical instrument and a young kid acrobat travel town to town with their white poodle earning money performing for the rich residents by the beaches. They refuse an offer to sell the poodle. Then the dog is kidnapped.

Title: 364. A Life in the Balance
description: In Mexico City, a poor single father is mistaken for a serial killer by the local cops, but the man's son stumbles upon the real killer and tries to warn the police after being abducted.

Title: 365. Devil Goddess
description: Jungle Jim type Johnny Weissmuller helps Professor Blakely look for a missing colleague who is now playing "god" for a bunch of natives.

Title: 366. The African Lion
description: Experience the thrill of the hunt and the heartwarming fun of a mother lion caring for her playful cubs as wildlife experts Elma Milotte and Alfred Milotte spend three years on the plains of Africa studying the king of beasts.

Title: 367. The Lonesome Trail
description: A demobilized soldier's property and girl are abusively taken by a greedy rancher whose henchmen control the town but the ex soldier plans a decisive showdown with all of them.

Title: 368. Magdana's Donkey
description: Small Georgian village (ca. 1890) Magdana a widow lives in a shack with her 3 children and ekes out a living selling yogurt. When the children find a donkey lying by the road and nurse it to health, it seems the family's troubles are over.

Title: 369. Siamo uomini o caporali
description: These are the years of the Second World War, and Toto is imprisoned in a concentration camp, suffering the harassment of Colonel Hammler, a cruel, despotic Nazi.

Title: 370. Ernst Thälmann - Führer seiner Klasse
description: The second part of the Ernst Thälmann films encompasses the time period between 1930 and Thälmann's murder in 1944. It shows Thälmann's battle to achieve a united front with all German workers against the National Socialists, his arrest following Hitler's seizure of power and the eleven years of his incarceration, in which he is unwavering in his beliefs until his death. An attempt to free him on the part of his comrades ends disastrously, and a corrupt offer of freedom from Göring himself receives Thälmann's refusal. He must also witness how his brave fellow Socialist Aenne Jansen in the women's prison across from his tragically loses her life during a bombing raid. The second primary character of the film is Aenne's husband Fiete Jansen, who already proved his loyalty to Thälmann's side as a friend and fighter in the first part. As the commander of the Thälmann Battalion, he fights in Spain on the side of the people and later in the ranks of the Red Army toward a speedy end to the war against Fascism.

Title: 371. Tower of Lust
description: Under the reign of Louis X, the Tower of Nesle is the scene of murderous bacchanals, of which passing gentlemen are victims. The valiant Captain Buridan escapes the assassins and unmasks the instigator of these crimes.

Title: 372. Gang Busters
description: Hardened criminal repeatedly breaks out of Oregon State Prison, eluding police for prolonged periods afterwards.

Title: 373. La fuerza del deseo
description: Las pasiones y el drama se desencadenan cuando es imposible dominar el deseo ante una mujer bonita.

Title: 374. Tiger Girl
description: The story is about heiress of the circus family who organizes show "Let's get married" right in the cage for the tigers.

Title: 375. Uçan daireler Istanbul'da
description: Alien Amazon women land their UFO in Istanbul to find Earth men for their home planet with the help of a robot. Two bumbling journalists are caught up in the action.

Title: 377. An Annapolis Story
description: Two brothers, enrolled at the U.S. Naval Academy on the verge of the Korean War, fall in love with the same girl.

Title: 378. Hanussen
description: In Germany before World War II, a well-known psychic decides to collaborate with the Nazis.

Title: 380. Jan Hus
description: During the Great Papal Schism, protestant reformer, Jan Hus, speaks out against the rampant corruption of the Church in Rome, kickstarting a religious revolution in Bohemia.

Title: 381. Gli sbandati
description: In the summer of 1943 Countess Luisa and her son Andrea left Milan to escape the bombings and retreated to their country villa, where they host two of Andrea's contemporaries, cousin Carlo, son of a fascist hierarch who fled to Switzerland, and friend Ferruccio, son of an army officer engaged in war.

Title: 382. Hell's Horizon
description: Interaction among men of a bombing squadron during the Korean War.

Title: 383. You Lucky People!
description: Tribulations of inept reservists who find a fortnight's training an unwelcome interruption.

Title: 384. John and Julie
description: An English boy and girl run away to London to see the coronation of Elizabeth II.

Title: 385. Sky Without Stars
description: A border police officer helps a woman cross between West and East Germany with her son. Despite being increasingly united by love, the distance between them increases as border security tightens.

Title: 386. The Tattered Wings
description: A widow life is left in turmoil when her childhood lover returns to town, left between the decision whether to go with him and start a new life in tokyo or settle down with her kindly brother-in-law, amidst a growing scandal that could tatter her family name.

Title: 387. Lovers' Net
description: He is a French taxi driver in Lisbon carrying the scars of a wife's infidelity that ended in tragedy when he found her with his lover upon returning from the war. She is a French woman in trouble with the law and she has a police inspector on her tail. They fall passionately in love, but because of his past he is not able to trust that she is not using him to escape the police. She must choose between escaping with him and remaining under a shred of doubt or turn herself in to prove that she indeed loves him.

Title: 388. Ten Little Pin-Ups
description: A mid-1950s burlesque-revue centered on a lively contest to crown "Miss Pin-Up of 1955." Guided by Randy Knight as master of ceremonies, each contestant takes the stage for a musical routine blending dance, glamour, and playful charm. The showcase builds toward the final selection of the winning pin-up.

Title: 389. Dial Red O
description: Upon receiving a divorce summons, a patient escapes from a mental institution, only to become the prime suspect in his wife's murder.

Title: 390. Jibun no ana no nakade
description: Amidst endless construction and aircraft noise, a family whose father died slowly disintegrates. While daughter Tamiko struggles with her stepmother Nobuko's attempts to marry her off to careless physician Ihura, her bed-ridden brother Junjiro grieves for his ex-wife Keiko who left him for another man. Although Ihura is more interested in Nobuko, he has a short-lived affair with Tamiko, who herself cares only for Ihura's future social and financial status. After selling the family's last remaining properties, Tamiko and Junjiro refuse to give Nobuko her share. Nobuko moves out of the house, announcing that she will take legal steps against her stepchildren's decision. Shortly before his death, Junjiro confesses to Tamiko that he lost the family's money and the mortgaged house in ill-fated stock market investments.

Title: 391. Die Deutschmeister
description: Young Stanzi who is visiting Vienna helps a young corporal and musician to become famous for his marching song "Die Deutschmeister".

Title: 392. Wiretapper
description: An Army ex-con electronics engineer sells his skills to a violent crime boss for big money as his loving Christian wife begs him to stop.

Title: 393. Beautiful Days
description: Masaki Kobayashi directs this romantic drama concerning a family of florists.

Title: 394. Le couteau sous la gorge
description: Pacos Le Maltais, leader of a gang,lays down the law on the quay of Marseille .He fires one of his henchmen ,Le Chinois ,who killed a woman during the last bank stickup.

Title: 395. Seema
description: An orphan gets in trouble with the law and is sent to a home for young women. There, for the first time, she finds friendship, compassion, and possibly love.

Title: 396. Bengazi
description: An American with a shady past joins with a morally-bankrupt Irishman to find treasure buried by Arabs in a deserted mosque in the Sahara. The situation becomes complicated when they are surrounded by bellicose Bedouin bandits.

Title: 397. The Way Out
description: A man claims innocence after being accused of murdering a bookie. His wife and brother-in-law investigate, uncovering inconsistencies as they search for the real culprit.

Title: 398. Uran Khatola
description: A man's plane crashes in a city that is ruled by women and he starts liking the peasant girl who rescues him. However, the queen of the city also likes him but discovers that he likes someone else.

Title: 399. Top of the World
description: A jet pilot, Dale Robertson, find himself assigned to the barren wastes of Alaska where it becomes his duty to man an observation post.

Title: 400. Meeuwen sterven in de haven
description: A pessimistic urban drama, with a musical score by Jack Sels and Max Damasse, charts in strongly expressionistically lit black-and-white images the wanderings of a tormented man through the cosmopolitan port city of Antwerp. The only people to show him understanding are an orphan and two disillusioned women.

Title: 401. Un soir de joie
description: Based on a true story from November 1943 : the Resistance manages to publish a fake edition of the pro-German newspaper 'Le Soir', put on sale by surprise in the newsstands and stuffed full of parodic articles pouring ridicule upon occupying forces. The film faithfully traced the course of this humorous and enterprising attempt to wake up the populace, filling out the basic plot with irreverent patriotic gags.

Title: 402. Cartouche
description: Jacques de Maudy, the son of a sick nobleman, returns to France to try and clear his name from a framed-up crime. He avoids the traps sets for him and, with the aid of an actors' troupe, gathers the evidence against the true guilty party. The governor declares him innocent and his fortune and titles are returned to him.

Title: 403. Nubes de verano
description: Vicente a simple and honest shopkeeper, who is desperate as he can't pay a letter of credit the next day. He humbly asks a few people he knows are well-off to lend him the money, and one by one they all refuse, with lame excuses. Later in the day, Vicente considers suicide: anything but dishonor. And then, one by one, people he wouldn't turn to, interrupt his dark thoughts to offer him money: his daughter's fiancé had been saving money for the marriage; his wife had a secret nest-egg... Vicente is a man reborn.

Title: 405. The Brain Machine
description: A doctor is taken hostage by a drug smuggler whom she has diagnosed as psychotic. Her estranged husband has to find her before the smuggling gang find him and kill them both.

Title: 406. Liliomfi
description: Mariska and Liliomfi fall in love without suspecting that Mariska's foster father is also Liliomfi's uncle. Soon the couple must contend with the professor's plan to make Liliomfi give up his "unrespectable" profession of acting.

Title: 407. Wyoming Renegades
description: Brady Sutton, ex-convict and former Butch Cassidy gang member, gets wrongly accused of bank robbery. Escaping mob, he rejoins Cassidy's gang to prove innocence and bring them to justice.

Title: 408. One Good Turn
description: Norman is the oldest orphan at Greenwood Children's Home and now acts as their caretaker. All the orphans are very happy and well cared for. The adventures start when a nasty property developer (boo hiss!) who is also the chairman of the orphanage board wants to close the orphanage and build a factory on the site. The children are sent to Brighton for the day and Norman is very excited because he's "never seen the sea". When they get back, they discover the plan to close the orphanage and must decide what to do.

Title: 409. Vachan
description: Kamla lives a poor lifestyle in a small town in Uttar Pradesh, India, along with her widowed dad, Dinanath, who works as an Accountant with Sarpanch Journal, and two younger brothers, college-going Kumar, and school-going 12 year old brother, Kishore. Dinanath's main aim is to get Kamla married to her lover, wealthy Prem, and ensure that Kumar and Kishore get a proper college education. When Dinanath's eyesight becomes very weak, he starts making errors, and loses his job. He does manage to persuade his employer, Laxmidas, to hire Kumar once he gets his degree in Arts. On the day of the results, Kumar has an accident and passes away, a devastated Dinanath bangs his head, injures himself, is hospitalized, recovers but loses his vision completely. As a result, Kamla's wedding is canceled, Prem reluctantly gets married to Shyama; while Kamla gets a job and starts to look after her dad and Kishore. Years pass by, Kishore has grown up, graduates, gets a job, gets married to Tara, the niece of Kashiram, Prem's Munshi. The family settles down to a fairly harmonious relationship which is shattered when Kishore and Tara accuse Kamla of stealing household items, resulting in Kamla and her dad moving out of the house. Kamla and her dad live a near-destitute life, and Kamla gets a job to look after an ailing Shyama, while Prem is away. Watch what happens when Shyama finds out that she has hired her husband's ex-lover, and the very woman she suspects is still having an affair with him.

Title: 410. A Yank in Ermine
description: An American airman (Peter Thompson) inherits an English title, but will he cope with English nobility?

Title: 411. There Was Once a King...
description: A story about a king who out of three daughters preferred two: the most beautiful and the most cheerful, and the most intelligent, and even able to cook well, he kicked out, which he later bitterly regretted.

Title: 412. Coyote
description: In 1848 the USA annex California, Hispanics are now discriminated by the Yankees. To end the abuse Don César orders his student son to return from Europe. The locals laugh about this ridiculous dandy. But all is not what it seems.

Title: 413. Yo fui novio de Rosita Alvírez
414. The Toughest Man Alive
description: A U.S. agent diguises himself as a gunrunner to smash an international smuggling ring.

Title: 415. Flame of the Islands
description: The story of a café singer who buys a gambling casino, and the men who fall in love with her.

Title: 416. The White Angel
description: Widowed and having lost his two children, Guido yearns for the nun Luisa, the woman with whom he had a relationship in "Nobody's Children", the first part of this duology. Then he meets Lina, a chorus dancer who looks just like Luisa.

Title: 417. El asesino X
description: A man shoots four times to another man and then surrenders to the police. Despite several interrogations, he refuses to reveal his identity. His photograph appears in the newspaper and who could be his mother thinks he recognizes him.

Title: 418. Azaad
description: After Azaad, a rich man, rescues Shobha from a few bandits, she decides to marry him. Things take a turn when Shobha's family discovers that Azaad himself is a bandit.

Title: 420. The Love Match
description: Two football-loving railway workers get into trouble after racing their engine home to get to a match on time.

Title: 421. Lord of the Jungle
description: Mona Andrews arrives by plane in Laghaso Station, Africa, to visit her uncle, Commissioner Andy Barnes, just as three elephant hunters, Jeff Woode, Paul Gavin and Kenny Balou, set out under orders from the district governor to exterminate a herd of elephants that has been terrorizing native villages. Bomba is appalled by this as the elephants are his friends and he knows they are being led by one rogue bull. He is willing to have the rogue bull killed but not the others. The three hunters, evidently paid by the head, seize Bomba, tie him and leave him guarded by two natives, Eli and Molu. Mona helps Bomba escape and he locates the herd and arranges for the rogue elephant to be killed by Barnes as, despite reports elsewhere to the contrary, Bomba kills no elephants before, during or after their time.

Title: 422. Piccola posta
description: Polish countess Lady Eva is the authoritative signature of the correspondence of an Italian women's magazine; behind the fascinating name hides a Roman girl whose advice will create a series of tangled and comic situations.

Title: 423. Yellowneck
description: 5 Confederate soldiers desert, make their way through the Everglades and try to make it to Cuba.

Title: 424. Cinerama Holiday
description: Travelogue featuring an American couple traveling in Europe and a European couple traveling in the U.S, with the emphasis on the cinematography which was viewed on a special curved screen with three projectors.

Title: 425. Hanka
description: Village drama of love and hate among the Gypsies.

Title: 426. Gu xing xue lei
description: Lee plays a young man who comes under the tutelage of a convict and must make hard choices about his life's direction.

Title: 427. Fire in the Night
description: Tim works at a newspaper during day time, and is a pyromaniac at night. Only the newspaper's editor, which also is a childhood friend, knows about Tim's dark side. Until Margrethe also gets to know.

Title: 428. Hold Back Tomorrow
description: A condemned murderer, scheduled to hang in the morning, asks for the company of a woman in his final hours.

Title: 429. Ich denke oft an Piroschka
description: Andreas, a young German student, comes to Hungary on an exchange programme. In the Hungarian village he falls in love with the stationmaster's daughter Piroschka and spends much of his time with her. They have an enchanting summer until Andreas gets an invitation to join another young woman at a nearby resort. Piroschka is jealous and follows him there, causing trouble. It takes a long time for Andreas and Piroschka to even talk to each other again. When Andreas must leave Hungary at the end of his holiday, he is determined to return someday.

Title: 430. The Glass Tomb
description: Crowds flock to a carnival sideshow to see "The Starving Man", a heavyset man who claims he can go 70 days without eating. However, a couple of murders occur at the carnival, resulting in the police becoming involved.

Title: 431. Tres bribones
description: Three men are left to care for a newborn baby after receiving a mysterious message. The note claims the mother is gone and that one of the three men is the biological father, forcing them to face unexpected fatherhood.

Title: 432. Donga Ramudu
description: Ramudu (Akkineni Nageshwara Rao) after serving a jail sentence for a theft he had committed during childhood to buy medicines for his mother (Hemalatha) lands in a job as a servant at moneylender Veerabhadraiah's (Relangi) house. He finds his sister Lakshmi (Jamuna) in an orphanage and promises to pay her college fee. To raise the money, he steals at Bhadraiah's house but is caught and jailed. Lakshmi escapes an attack by Babulu (R. Nageswara Rao) a local thug, with the help of Seetha (Savitri) the vegetable vendor with whom Ramudu is in love. Seetha gets shelter for her at Dr. Mohan's (Jaggaiah) house. Impressed by her virtues, the doctor decides to marry Lakshmi. Ramudu joins as a driver with Mohan. He warns his sister not to reveal that they are siblings. But Veerabhadraiah who is angry that the doctor has not married his daughter (Swarajyalakshmi), reveals their identity and that Ramudu is a thief. Veerabhadraiah is murdered by Babulu but the blame falls on Ramudu. Seetha helps prove Ramudu's innocence by bringing Babulu to book. The story ends on a happy note.

Title: 433. Bring Your Smile Along
description: A New England schoolteacher goes to New York to become a songwriter.

Title: 434. Totò all'inferno
description: After several attempts at suicide, depressed thief Antonio Marchi accidentally drowns in a river and ends up in hell.

Title: 435. Pobre huerfanita
description: A little girl without a family makes her way in the world, earning everyone's love and admiration with her sweetness and courage.

Title: 436. Desert Sands
description: The French Foreign Legion battles rebellious Arabs in North Africa.

Title: 437. Amor en cuatro tiempos
description: The film presents four narratives, each providing a unique view on love. It illustrates the love or lack of between spouses, lovers, and children, and it analyzes this complex topic in many facets that go from compassion to homicidal instincts.

Title: 438. 8 X 8: A Chess Sonata in 8 Movements
description: It is a fairy tale for the subconscious based on the game of chess. Partly Sigmund Freud, partly Lewis Carroll.

Title: 439. The Babes Make the Law
description: When Nathalie, a shoe seller, is abducted, her mother Flora wastes no time taking matters into her own hands. Reluctant to call in the police, she galvanizes her three other daughters into action.

Title: 440. Spy Chasers
description: Slip, Sach and the gang get mixed up in political intrigue when they try to help an exiled European king and his daughter regain the throne that is rightfully theirs.

Title: 441. Forbidden
description: Don Paolo, a young parson troubled by his love for Agnese, tries to make peace in a little village in Sardinia where two families are at war.

Title: 442. Lo que le pasó a Sansón
description: A lazy man and his jealous hairdresser girlfriend watch "Samson and Delilah" at the movies. Later, he dreams he's Samson, falling for Delilah despite his love for Miriam. After losing his strength, he must confront Prince Arthur.

Title: 443. Vildfåglar
description: A Swedish noir movie with the character of a French noir ('Quai des brumes', 'Le jour se lève'). Two worlds meet for a brief experience of happiness ended by a violent tragedy. In one world the unhappy prostitute (Ulla) finds a drunken young man (Nisse) who had previously failed in many occupations. She takes him home. Her feelings are like those for a younger brother. Nisse moves into the small apartment next to hers. It was vacant because of a complex tragedy involving the piano teacher. Ulla becomes very distressed when Nisse joins a criminal gang. - In the other world a young girl Lena's father is the captain and her fiancé the first mate on the same boat. She feels almost imprisoned by the life she is expected to live. When her piano teacher failed to show up for several weeks she goes to his apartment. This is where Nisse lives now. It is not just that Nisse and Lena fall in love. She is revived by this relationship and fundamentally changes her view of life. Suddenly she no longer perceives it as a dreadful fate to bear children etc., if doing so together with Nisse. But their love is doomed. Lena's sister informs her father and fiancé. When they try to break in in Nisse's apartment, Lena shoots both Nisse and herself.

Title: 444. Savnet siden mandag
description: 17 year old Gunnar Holm is missing. Noone has seen his since Monday, and when his single mother returns. It seems that Gunnar has gotten involved with two rotten apples, and soon he is fleeing, being involved in a murder.

Title: 445. 08/15 - Zweiter Teil
description: Winter 1942: Like thousands of other German soldiers, Asch and Vierbein have ended up at the Eastern front.

Title: 446. Three Stripes in the Sun
description: Army Master Sergeant Hugh O'Reilly is stationed in Japan after World War II. He hates the Japanese. He meets a pretty young Japanese woman, an interpreter for the Army, and through her learns of an orphanage in need of help. He enlists other soldiers in an effort to rebuild the orphanage, and in doing so, begins to soften in his attitude toward the Japanese people.

Title: 447. It's a Great Day!
description: Bob Grove needs building materials to finish a housing estate job. His son illegally obtains them. The council discovers this and calls the police. The Groves try to resolve the situation before the housing estate grand opening.

Title: 448. La vida no vale nada
description: Con una perspectiva un poco fatalista sobre la naturaleza humana y la búsqueda de la felicidad a través del amor, Pablo experimenta de manera cínica algunas relaciones sin éxito.

Title: 449. The Missing Scientists
description: Two international atomic scientists working in London go missing in mysterious circumstances.

Title: 450. Bad Liaisons
description: A woman tells her life story to a police investigator after a doctor's suicide.

Title: 451. Jail Busters
description: Chuck, a reporter for The Blade newspaper, gets beaten up while trying to get a story on prison corruption, and the rest of the Bowery Boys, Slip, Sach, and Butch, get themselves arrested so that they can complete the expose from inside the prison, while serving a short---they think---six month sentence. Inside the Big House, they learn that ex-gangsters Ed Lannigan, Tom Tomcyk, and "Big Greenie", are living in the lap of luxury within the prison, by paying off Jenkins, the corrupt Captain of the Guards. And, on the side, the Boys, Sach in particular, slowly send Dr. Fordyce, the prison psychiatrist, off the deep end as they clumsily go about their investigation.

Title: 453. Insaniyat
description: A once loyal soldier faces many challenges after turning into a rebel.

Title: 454. The Maiden
description: A lot of robbed jewels is out in the nature, and no one knows where it is hidden. Possibly the robber's girlfriend knows. When she is out of prison, and returns to her cabaret show in Montparnasse, the police is after her to discover her secret. But the police is not alone. The girl from Pigalle will discover love, and lose it, while the undercover cop will discover the jewels, lose them, and find love.

Title: 455. Les Aristocrates
description: In Burgundy area, the Marquis De Maubrun, worthy heir of the aristocratic virtues and traditions, reigns over his family and estate. But wind of revolt is about to blow above Maubrun's head.

Title: 456. Shap Mochan
description: Mhanedra Mukhopadhaya ( Uttam Kumar ) is a descendant of a musician family. One of his forefathers was cursed by his guru that anyone in his family who would practice music will either die prematurely or be disabled because he insulted the guru by not accepting him as the guru. Mahendra's elder brother Devendra ( Pahadi Sanyal ) was blinded by the curse and he vowed not to practice music and obtained commitment from Mahendra that he will also not practice music. Because of extreme poverty Devendra sends Mahendra to Calcutta to His friend ( Kamal Mitra ) to help Mahendra get a job and earn money to help the family. His daughter Madhuri ( Suchitra Sen ) takes care of Mahendra and polishes him for the high society including the table manners. Madhuri finds Mahendra's musical talent and promises him to help build a career in music and when learns about the curse she assures Mahendra that she does not believe it and will do everything possible to get rid of that curse from him and his family. Finding a job was difficult in those days and Mahendra had to settle for singing to earn a living knowing about the curse and gradually establishes himself as a notable singer and starts making good money. Watch what happens when the curse still falls upon the family Mahendra is saved from his grave illness by Madhuri......

Title: 457. Sanshiro Sugata
description: The story of Sanshiro Sugata, a young man who wants to learn the new art of judo. A wise teacher reveals to Sanshiro that judo is not merely a means of combat nor a demonstration of physical skill, but an art which reveals the artist to himself.

Title: 458. Escuela de música
description: About an industrialist with lots of money and a singing teacher forced to leave school because she lacks financial resources. Thanks to their singing skills, they will join in a tour through different countries of Latin America.

Title: 460. High Society
description: Sach becomes a pawn in a crooked trio's scheme to swindle an inheritance from its rightful pre-adolescent heir.

Title: 461. Historias de la radio
description: Three different stories whose central axis are radio listeners: several contestants have to get to a radio station studio dressed as Eskimo, a thief answering a call in the house which is stealing and a school teacher who participates in a contest to get money to cure a child of his village. The stories are linked by the love story of a speaker and his fiancée and through interviews of real celebrities from the time of film.

Title: 462. Betrayed Women
description: The governor appoints lawyer Jeff Darrow to open an investigation on the reported cruelties inflicted on the inmates of the Bayou Reformatory For Women. The investigation is opposed by Mrs. Ballard, head of the prison, whose moronic brother, Cletus, is keeper of the prison bloodhounds. Nora Collins, once engaged to Jeff, but now an inmate because she had stolen to protect her brother, is resentful of prison methods and particularly bitter against the sadistic methods of a brutal prison guard named Darcy. Honey Blake and Kate unsuccessfully try to use Cletus in an escape attempt. But they try a second escape using Jeff, Nora and Mrs. Ballard as hostages. Mabry, Kate's gangland lover, hears of the escape and knowing she will go where she had hidden $50,000 gets there ahead of her.

Title: 463. Koko ni izumi ari
description: The story of a group of young people who organize their own travelling symphony orchestra to provide music for people living in remote villages shortly after the war.

Title: 464. Abdullah's Harem
description: Abdullah, absolute monarch of a wealthy Middle Eastern country, has everything a man could want. Everything, that is, until he falls for a beautiful model. She rejects his advances, however, along with his offers of riches and luxury, chosing instead an officer in the king's army as her lover. As all of this is going on, the ruler is oblivious to the growing discontent among his subjects, and the threat of revolt that is increasing with each passing day.

Title: 466. Sons, Mothers and a General
description: As Germany's fortunes in the latter part of World War II wane, several young boys, in their enthusiasm to do something "for the fatherland", volunteer to fight with the German army in the East. Horrified at the news that their children are to be sent to the Russian front, the boys' mothers begin a desperate effort to get their sons back.

Title: 467. Das Lied der Hohen Tauern
description: During the construction of the Kaprun power plant in the Salzburg region, the engineer asks an experienced mountain guide for help. After he refuses, only his former love can change his mind.

Title: 469. Hjem går vi ikke
description: A six year old boy runs away from home with the family's big dog, a St. Berhard, who the grown ups wants to put down.

Title: 470. Bedre enn sitt rykte
description:
The main character Dag falls in love with his young French language teacher. It becomes a complicated love story when Dag's class mate Karin is also fancying Dag, and Dag's best friend, Roald, is deeply in love with Karin.

The Russ (a special celebration when finishing High School) at that time were more innocent than today's generations. The craziest stunt in this movie is a bath in the fameous fountain of Vigeland - wearing swimming trunks!

Title: 471. Mademoiselle from Paris
description: Musical about a young lady who is in love with her boss, struggling to keep his fancy Paris shop open for business.

Title: 472. Las Vegas Shakedown
description: A teacher writing a book about gambling meets a hotel/casino owner threatened by a gangster.

Title: 473. Aghla Min Aynayeh
description: A fire breaks out in Kamal's home so he rushes in to save his mother, but his face gets disfigured. His fiancée leaves him, he loses his job and his life spirals until he meets Hoda, a blind girl, who loves him deeply.

Title: 475. Canario rojo
description: A girl who failed her exam harasses her music teacher.

Title: 476. The Lyons Abroad
description: Has Ben Lyon forgotten his wedding anniversary? His wife Bebe thinks he has, and can hardly contain her fury. When his son Richard sees him dining with a glamorous French singer he thinks the worst.

Title: 477. Special Delivery
description: The Pacific Rim's best bonded courier is tasked with delivering a bratty 15-year-old to her mother in the U.S. amid a bitter custody battle and escalating stakes.

Title: 478. Jagriti
description: Sent to a hostel as a punishment, a rebellious lad leads a revolt and creates havoc in the institution.

Title: 479. Battle Taxi
description: In the Korean war, the commander of an Air Rescue helicopter team must show a hot-shot former jet pilot how important helicopter rescue work is and turn him into a team player.

Title: 480. Raising a Riot
description: Tony Kent returns home after 3 years in the Navy to find his children are strangers. After his wife is suddenly called away, Tony takes his brood to his father's windmill home where he tries to bond with Peter, Anne and Fusty.

Title: 481. Totò e Carolina
description: During a police raid at Villa Borghese, the agent, a widower named Antonio Caccavallo, stays to get better acquainted with the young Carolina.

Title: 482. The Deadliest Sin
description: A falling-out between thieves over the proceeds of a stickup results in several killings and a priest being marked for murder because of a confession he heard from one of the gang members.

Title: 483. Maboroshi no uma
description: Following the tragic death of his father, a young boy's family trains his horse to compete in the local derby.

Title: 484. One Jump Ahead
description: A hard-boiled reporter tries to solve a mysterious crime despite an increasingly complicated love life.

Title: 485. Two-Gun Lady
description: A young woman teaches herself to become a sharpshooter so she can hunt down the three men who murdered her parents. She finds a sheriff who is willing to help her track them down.

Title: 486. No Smoking
description: Reg is a scientist who invents a pill to cure smokers of their nicotine addiction. However, when he makes his discovery public, he encounters strong resistance from the tobacco industry.

Title: 487. Chilam Balam
description: At the beginning of the 16th century, the Mayan civilization, in full political and social decline, was defeated by the Spanish conquerors. In the midst of the clash, Naya, daughter of the powerful fortune teller Chilam Balam, ends up joining the son of the Spaniard Montejo, giving rise to a new racial mixture.

Title: 488. House of Many Pleasures
description: Yoshida Denkichi loses sight of his wife Chiyoko and daughter Toyoko during the war, and is taken in by a familiar woman, Oshige, and becomes the owner of "Fujimura" in the town of Hato. Eiko is a timid woman who hates Terada, a watchmaker who is obsessed with her; Tamie is a hard worker who asks for money from customers to support her mother and daughter Teruko; Tane, who dreams of the day they can be together, gives money to her lover Takeda; Machiko is selective about her customers in the name of romance. They are women working in the red light district at "Fujimura."

Title: 489. Señora ama
description: A wealthy couple is hampered by having no children. The sister-in-law feels attracted to the husband and marries his brother. Tension raises between them when the wife feels ill.

Title: 490. Touch and Go
description: After Jim Fletcher is told by his firm that his new furniture designs are not in keeping with the firm's image, he threatens to resign and decides to uproot his family and emigrate to Australia. but his problems are only just beginning.

Title: 491. La vena d'oro
description: Jealous of his widowed mother's new lover, a boy does everything to separate them. Then, after he realizes their profound feelings for each other, he tries to reunite them.

Title: 492. The Lone Ranger Story
description: Anniversary show filmed for the 22nd anniversary of the lone ranger.

Title: 493. Josephine and Men
description: The trouble with Josephine is that her ever-loving and over-sympathetic nature leads her to switch from needful men to even more needful men...

Title: 495. Yo no creo en los hombres
description: In Havana, humble office girl Maria Caridad becomes the victim of rich playboy Arturo who seduces her and takes her to bed under false pretenses.

Title: 496. The Gold Express
description: The robbery of gold is planned from a train which also carries several eccentric passengers, including two elderly ladies who write lurid thrillers under a pseudonym.

Title: 497. The Secret
description: Diamond smuggling, and the disappearance of the mother of several children, in the seaside resort of Brighton after World War II.

Title: 498. La mujer X
description: Una mamá es separada injustamente de su hijo y tratará de encontrarlo. Las circunstancias de cuando lo reencuentra, la obligarán a cometer un asesinato. Ya en juicio su hijo se encarga de la defensa, sin embargo ella no quiere exponerle el motivo que la orilló a tomar dicha decisión.

Title: 499. La fuerza de los humildes
description: Unethical industrialist gets taken down by a combination of forces including labor activists and a kill-crazy tribal Indian.

Title: 500. Railway Platform
description: Passengers from all backgrounds get stranded on an isolated railway platform when a natural disaster delays their train for 24 hours.

Title: 501. Kyôdai
description: Based on the biographical story by Fumi Kuroyanagi, the film is about the hardships of two sisters living in 1950s Japan.

Title: 503. Det var paa Rundetaarn
description: On a sunny Sunday in Copenhagen, a thief's action will bring people together resulting in romance and a wife suspecting adultery.

Title: 504. Después de la tormenta
description: On an island two sisters are married to twin brothers.When there is a storm while the men have gone out to sea and only one brother returns, there is some uncertainty between the women as to whose husband he is.

Title: 505. Il principe dalla maschera rossa
description: Duke Altichieri rises to power, after his associate, Cpt. Alberico, kills governor Conte Filippo della Scala. 10 harsh years of tyranny follow, until a mysterious figure appears out of nowhere, helping people in their struggle against the regime. He is known by the name Red-Masked Prince, but who is he?

Title: 506. Ripudiata
description: A young woman is wrongly accused of adultery. Forced to flee by her husband, she becomes a successful opera singer and when war comes, returns home to see her son and clear her name.

Title: 507. Ça va barder
description: A con man (Eddie Constantine) is approached by a shipping magnate to become one of his security agents.

Title: 508. Jhanak Jhanak Payal Baaje
description: Dance guru Mangal trains Neela for a competition, pairing her with his son Giridhar, but when they fall in love and neglect their routine, Mangal plans to replace her.

Title: 509. The Life and Loves of Mozart
description: Explores the mental state of Mozart during production of his final opera "Die Zauberflöte".

Title: 510. Schneeweisschen und Rosenrot
description: Snow White and her sister Rose Red try to help two princes stop an evil dwarf from robbing the royalty of their wealth.

Title: 511. Sabar Uparey
description: A struggling attorney discovers his father was wrongfully imprisoned for murder years ago. Determined to clear his father's name, he abandons his life and launches a personal investigation, facing dangerous obstacles that test his resolve.

Title: 512. Texas Lady
description: A strong-headed woman from the East inherits a newspaper in a small Texas town where the local cattle barons, who control the region, want her out of their hair.

Title: 513. Apache Ambush
description: After the Civil War, government envoys organize a cattle drive from Texas to Kansas but Mexican bandits and Apache renegades plan to steal the cattle and a secret shipment of Henry repeating rifles.

Title: 514. Dig That Uranium
description: Boys purchase a uranium mine out west, only to find it worthless. Local badmen, mistakenly believing it's loaded with uranium, scheme to eliminate the boys and seize the mine.

Title: 515. Twilight Saloon
description: Set in a tavern, director Tomu Uchida depicts the joys and sorrows of the people who gather there in an experimental style, weaving in a variety of music in this ambitious ensemble drama.

Title: 516. Baap Re Baap
description: Raj Kumar Ashok belongs to a rich and aristocratic family. His parents want him to marry the best of the best girls money could find. Ashok's dad then spends a lot of money to invite proposals from all over India. But Ashok loves Kokila, who belongs to a poor family and sells flowers for a livelihood. Ashok decides to carry on his love with Kokila and at the same time witnesses the hilarious goings-on at his residence when the dads, mom, and the brides-to-be assemble - all from different parts of India - all speaking a different language. And with this multi-lingual medley, misunderstandings are bound to happen - and they do. His parents eventually select Roopa to be the bride. What will happen to the budding romance of Ashok and Kokila?

Title: 517. Pehli Jhalak
description: A woman rejects her father-approved groom, runs away, and falls in love with a petty thief/gambler.

Title: 520. El caso de la mujer asesinadita
description: A wealthy woman shares a routine existence with her husband. One night, she has a strange dream where a couple breaks into her house claiming that it is their own home.

Title: 521. House on the Waterfront
description: Martine is searching for her sister that disappeared mysteriously. Lequévic agrees to help her.

Title: 522. Arthurs forbrytelse
description: Arthur Sellmann is marrying Irene, and his friend, the spiritual Diana makes him read his future in the palm of his hands every week. Maybe he shouldn't have started believing what he is told.

Title: 523. Joe the Terrible
description: After one month of planning, the first-time safe-breaker, Joe, tries to rob a haughty Russian aristocrat, only to realise that someone else has already emptied the safe of its contents. Can he convince everyone of his tainted innocence?

Title: 524. Luffaren och Rasmus
description: Rasmus run away from an orphanage to look for some parents who want a boy with straight hair. He meets the tramp Paradis-Oskar and joins him on the road.

Title: 526. Missamma
description: A rom-com involving Rao and Mary, two unemployed new graduates, who decide to act as a married couple so that they qualify for two teaching jobs at a High School and eventually fall in love.

Title: 528. Meoto zenzai
description: Despite paternal disapproval, the heir of a wealthy family embarks on a relationship with a Geisha.

Title: 529. 08/15 - In der Heimat
description: In the spring of 1945, the German troops are practically defeated, and the battalion of Kowalski, major general von Plönnies and Asch is left to its own devices to a large extent.

Title: 530. Bravissimo
description: The master Impallato takes care of the boys in a suburban after-school. Here he discovers a pupil with an extraordinary baritone voice.

Title: 532. Pirates of Tripoli
description: Princess Karjan promises pirate captain Edri el-Gadrian a fabulous reward if he helps her regain her lost kingdom of Misurata from Malek. After the latter destroys el-Gadrian's armada, he and Karjan enter Misurata in disguise in order to get Karjan's hidden jewels to buy new ships.

Title: 533. Jubilej gospodina Ikla
description: A man wakes up in his grave and realizes that he's been buried alive. He gets up and arrives home only to find out that his wife and relatives throw up a party instead of function, looking forward to his big inheritance.

Title: 534. The Gilded Cage
description: Steve and Harry become involved in an art theft. Harry is framed by the crooks, and arrested by the police. Steve has to prove his brother's innocence.

Title: 535. El fantasma de la opereta
description: A bloody serial killer Phantom kills and slash chorus girls. Not to be confused with the "Phantom of the Opera".

Title: 536. El monstruo en la sombra
description: A drug dealer is murdered and an innocent man is accused. Chan Li Po investigates a series of people from different social spheres, all addicted to marijuana, to finally discover the real culprit, who turns out to be the dealer's own wife.

Title: 537. El rayo justiciero
description: Captain Mauricio Rosales is already known to everyone, even in the most hidden corners of the sierras. Wherever there is injustice and evil, there he will always be ¨El Rayo Justiciero¨.

Title: 538. All for Mary
description: In a Swiss Alpine resort shortly after the War, army officer Clive Norton and upper-class Humpy Miller both set their sights on Mary, the landlord's daughter. After the two come down with chicken pox, they are put in the charge of fellow guest Miss Cartwright, who turns out to be Humpy's old nanny. The two Englishmen unite not only against her tyranny but against a dense Greek who is also after Mary.

Title: 539. I Cover the Underworld
description: A priest is about to see his twin brother, whom he hasn't seen in a long time--because his brother, a gang leader, has been serving a stretch in prison.

Title: 540. Abu Hassan Pencuri
description: Abu Hassan is a person who lives on stealing and just wonders about in the city with his dear friend Kassim from one place to another place stealing stuff to make a living. One day as they were wondering in the city of Baghdad, they were stunned at the beauty of Princess Faridah who passed by escorted by her bodyguards. Abu Hassan dream that one day he could marry her. He was so into her that he wanted to meet her but impossibly enough the whole palace was guarded tightly and there was surely no way in. But his dream came true when he stole a magic cane. How far will he go with his dream of meeting the Princess?

Title: 541. Wenn der Vater mit dem Sohne
description: After Clown Teddy lost his son, he lost his gift for laughter. He opened a joke shop and lives above the shop. His landlady has had a foster son since birth, and Teddy decides to raise the child, who always believed that Teddy was his father. When the mother suddenly appears five years later and wants her son, Teddy decides to run away with the child and goes back onstage with his son. Will the family catch up with them, or will the mother never get her son back?

Title: 542. Lahn el wafaa
description: A young promising singer was orphaned and raised by a famous musician who was a dear friend of his parents and who also decided to keep away from women who hurt him and kept away from music too. It became very hard for the young musician to follow his dream, without hurting the man that raised him.

Title: 546. Ginza no onna
description: Ikuyo is the boss of Shizumoto, a geisha residence that employs four other women. All of them, simultaneously, reveal the extreme hardships of the profession. From the frustrated search for popularity in the newspapers, through the diffuse desires for motherhood and ending in disappointment in love, the five women survive under the incandescent sky of Ginza, one of the wealthiest neighborhoods in Tokyo. Told from the perspective of a recently hired young geisha apprentice, Women of Ginza is an acidic and lucid portrait of these women who, even in defeat, emerge enlightened.

Title: 547. 91:an Karlsson rycker in
description: 91:an comes to a small town to seek a job. He meets Axelsson who works at a confectionery and the two gets drafted into the military service.

Title: 548. Ostrov Sakhalin
description: A movie about the life of the largest island of the USSR.

Title: 549. Il prigioniero della montagna
description: Plain-looking Giovanni Testa can barely support his family from his artisan wharf. Angelic son Carlito is the meat in the sandwich when Giovanni's sexy wife Teresa bitterly compares him to his wealthy brother, ruthless businessman Enzo. Although innocent, Giovanni flees under the assumed name Guglielmo Razoni when Enzo is murdered just after they had a loud row when he asked in vain for a loan. Giovanni starts a new life as construction worker on a dam in the Dolomites, but gets entangled in more love and crime drama, while an old rival makes a move on Teresa.

Title: 550. Du bist die Richtige
description: Renowned physician Stefan finds his second wife Danica too flamboyant for his liking and rekindles the relationship with his first spouse Käthe and their teenage twins, though Käthe is wooed by a well-known pianist.

Title: 551. Ismail Yasin fi el-Gaish
description: Ismail receives a military draft notice and struggles to follow orders, leading to many comedic situations. Meanwhile, he experiences a love story complicated by a rival suitor.

Title: 552. Andrea Chenier
description: Andrea Chenier, poet and politician, falls in love with an aristocratic girl also lusted after by the servant Gerard. The French Revolution breaks out and Chenier and Gerard are among the leaders, but Chenier is a moderate. It doesn't take long for Gerard to bring him before the Committee of Public Safety and have him condemned.

Title: 553. Ein Herz voll Musik
description: Vico Hasenpfot (Vico Torriani) is the hockey star of HC St. Moritz. As a pilot, he becomes bobsleigh world champion, shines as a slalom star in Cortina d'Ampezzo, and excels at ski-joring in Arosa. He always wears the number 7 - and always has a different name. As the youngest scion of a millionaire hotelier dynasty, he wants to remain incognito. His biggest admirer, multimillionaire Ellinor Patton (Fita Benkhoff), is all the more astonished when he unexpectedly appears at her hotel table as a waiter. Vico is supposed to learn the trade from the ground up. But the moody American woman makes his life difficult. However, the beautiful flower seller Blanche (Ina Halley) knows how to comfort him. After work, he sings to her at a special Mantovani concert and reveals his heart to her. Not only Blanche, but also the orchestra conductor is amazed. He wants to hire Vico immediately. But none of this fits into the career plans of hotel manager Jean Hasenpfot. He transfers Blanche to Rome and instructs the managing director Léaux (Rudolf Vogel) to offer the agent Peer Saldo (Wolfgang Wahl) double commission if he does not hire waiter number 7 for Mantovani. It seems that the entire high-class world of high finance has conspired against Vico Hasenpfot. But the singing waiter with the melodious heart shows everyone that you can't treat a determined person like that.

Title: 556. Camino de Guanajuato
description: The loves of three singers: two young men and a girl who fail in a radio contest and form a trio.

Title: 557. One Way Out
description: As he is about to retire, a police officer discovers that his daughter is mixed up with a criminal gang and is about to go to prison for a crime she didn't commit. Against his better judgment, he comes up with a plan to keep her from going to prison.

Title: 558. Le ragazze di San Frediano
description: The story deals with the amorous escapades of handsome garage mechanic Bob (Antonio Cifariello).

Title: 561. Batas ng alipin
description: Violent emotions are stripped BARE - and a woman scorned STRIKES back with all the FURY of the oppressed.

Title: 563. Passage Home
description: A cargo ship takes on a female passenger. Can the Captain contain the crew and himself as they hit stormy conditions and emotions explode?

Title: 564. Blonde Blackmailer
description: After serving seven years for a murder he did not commit, Tony Pelassier, is determined to clear his name, but he finds that going back seven years in an attempt to piece together threads of information is not an easy task. A Scotland Yard detective tries to persuade him to forget the past but Tony and his fiancée, Marie, go ahead with the investigation. Tony had been convicted of the murder of a girl who was the cashier in the garage where he worked, and evidence at the trial showed her to be an accomplished blackmailer. Tony became involved by repairing a bracelet for her and taking it to her home where he was apparently the last to see her alive. Tony and Marie succeed in tracking down Carole Carlton, a model who had been a close friend of the murdered girl.

Title: 565. Ezo Gelin
description: International Adana Film Festival, Best 2nd Film.

Title: 566. The Girl Rush
description: Kim, a museum worker from Providence, Rhode Island, inherits half ownership of a Las Vegas hotel after her father dies.

Title: 567. The Plot to Assassinate Hitler
description: A disillusioned Wehrmacht officer named Colonel Claus von Stauffenberg and his co-conspirators attempt to assassinate Adolf Hitler on 20 July 1944.

Title: 568. Le dossier noir
description: Jacques Arnaud arrives in a small town somewhere in the province. Soon a citizen reports to him that strangers have broken into his house where they stole a mysterious "black dossier".

Title: 569. The French, They Are a Funny Race
description: Major Thompson, an Englishman living in France, comments in his memoirs on the peculiarities of his French wife and friends.

Title: 570. El gran circo Chamorro
description: A fair and hilarious story about faith, ambition, and love.

Title: 571. Secret Venture
description: An American is visiting Britain and finds himself in possession of a briefcase full of secret documents that the spies of many different countries seem determined to get.

Title: 574. Krvavi put
description: Yugoslav Partisans, captured by Germans, are sent to concentration camps in distant Norway. The local population helps some Partisans survive or flee to neutral Sweden.

Title: 575. The Fighting Chance
description: A horse trainer and his friend, a jockey, fall in love with the same girl. Complications ensue.

Title: 576. Attik's Street Organ
description: Amid a wave of mass emigration in early 1900s Greece, an impoverished laundress falls in love with a handsome aristocrat. However, prejudice and machinations keep them apart. They say love is blind, but is he truly hers to keep?

Title: 577. Los paquetes de Paquita
description: Paquita is a disgruntled maid working for a rich couple. But she has a more pressing issue: every man around her is after her "packages", even her boss.

Title: 578. Layali el hub
description: The moral conflict of a young man between showing gratitude to the man who raised him as father, and his innocent best friend

Title: 579. Verrat an Deutschland
description: Japan, 1941: Disguised as a journalist, Richard Sorge spies for the Russians. When he falls in love with a secretary, he is in danger of being exposed. A spy thriller based on true events.

Title: 580. Lay That Rifle Down
description: Judy works for a pittance as a char in her aunt's hotel. To add spice to her life she enrolls in a charm course but it's a scam. Soon the swindlers show up and plan to use her to con her aunt out of her money.

Title: 581. Headline Hunters
description: City Editor Ned Powers assigns student reporter David Flynn to veteran newsman Hugh Woodruff, primarily to get on Woodruff's nerves. David has long admired Woodruff, but is saddened to see the cynical and unprofessional state to which Woodruff has declined. Woodruff, for his part, tries to cure David of his idealism and cause him to leave the newspaper business. David, though, sticks to his guns and saves Woodruff's reputation by filing a big scoop under Woodruff's name after Woodruff had missed it. When a special skill of David's enables him to learn the truth about a sensational murder case, David tries to bring Woodruff into the investigation, in hopes not only of solving the murder but of rescuing Woodruff's ideals and career.

Title: 582. The Big Tip Off
description: Richard Conte plays two-bit newspaper columnist Johnny Denton, who gains notoriety by printing tips on upcoming gangland activities.

Title: 583. Millions on the Island
description: Three children, two brothers and their friend, win a lottery ticket at sports forecasting. Upon deciding not to tell their parents in order to buy a ship, two criminals find out about this and try to steal their money.

Title: 584. Bel Ami
description: In the 1880s, Georges Duroy, back from the Colonies, arrives in Paris with the firm intention of conquering the capital through his power of seduction, his selfishness and cynicism. Entering into journalism through the back door he will soon rise to the top with the support of several women: Madeleine Forestier, the wife of his journalist friend Charles; Clothilde de Marelle, his first mistress; Virginie Walter, the wife of a newspaper owner; Suzanne Walter, her daughter who eventually marries Duroy.

Title: 586. The Bewitched Boy
description: A naughty boy named Nils is shrunken to a small size after offending a tomte. He has to go on a voyage with geese across Lapland to fulfill the prophecy and turn back to normal.

Title: 587. Private Ivan
description: Ivan Brovkin doesn't fit into life of his village as he constantly does something wrong. After yet another failure he has to join the Soviet Army where he finally begins to improve. Meanwhile he writes letters home to the girl he loves.

Title: 588. Father, Mother, My Wife and I
description: Robert Langlois is now married to Catherine, the former housemaid. And they would live happily ever after if the housing crisis did not force them to live together with Gabrielle and Fernand, Robert's parents. For, despite the good will on either side, tension soon arises. What else to expect when there is too little space in their Montmartre apartment for four people (then for six then eight, the couple having... two pairs of twins!) ; the continued presence there of Fernand (who loves peace and quiet) after he is driven to retirement ; the difficult beginnings of Robert as a lawyer in a room of the apartment, etc... Other troubles follow and the harried family is on the verge of implosion...

Title: 589. The Time of His Life
description: The ex-convict father of a prominent society woman is released from prison, and goes to live with her. She pretends he is an old friend, but tries to keep him out of sight, but all he wants to do is go back to prison.

Title: 591. Naukari
description: Comic, tragic, and heartrending saga of Ratan Kumar Chaudhary (Kishore Kumar), who leaves his village, aging mom, and seriously ill sister, to obtain employment in Calcutta, only to end up in a tiny tenement apartment full of other unemployed youths. He falls in love with Seema (Sheila Ramani) who lives in the building opposite his, and she too falls in love with him. Her father will not permit her to marry an unemployed youth, and wants her to marry someone known to him. Ratan receives an employment offer from a firm in Bombay, and travels there, only to have his wallet stolen by a pickpocket (Mehmood), and ends up in jail for being a suspect himself. He reports for employment and is hired. He sends for Seema, and she leaves her family for Ratan. By the time Seema reaches Bombay, Ratan has lost his job, and is forced to lie to Seema. Why did Ratan lose his job?

Title: 592. Mãos Sangrentas
description: Prisoners of Ilha Anchieta penitentiary rise up, dominate the guards and run away. One of them, who dreams of seeing his mother again, meets a prostitute, and tells her his story.

Title: 593. Ardhangi
description: The story of a woman who changes her mentally disabled husband and educates him in order to fight against the injustice being done to her husband by his brother.

Title: 594. The Flying Eye
description: Colonel Audacious is an inventor and with the help of his young assistant, Barnstuffer, he invents a model aeroplane with a TV camera attached that can then fly around revealing all sorts of goings on. After a few slapstick goofs the flying eye reveals the activities of a gang of spies.

Title: 595. Oasis
description: The proprietor of a Moroccan oasis becomes involved with two foreign women, who it turns out have been hired to keep an eye on him, as he is suspected of gold smuggling.

Title: 596. Missiamma
description: A hilarious comedy about two unemployed college graduates from the city, who pretend to be a married couple, in order to find work as school teachers in a small village.

Title: 598. The Tank Brigade
description: The film is depicting Czechoslovak tank brigade fighting along with the Red Army in the WW II. During the War Czechoslovak armored brigade was formed and trained in the Soviet Union. Although aware that they will be fighting mighty enemy and that many of them will not survive, that did not stop them. Brigade was performing successfully in the battles for Kiev, Rudi, Bela Czernaczovo Cerkev and became renown in the battles for Dukla i Ostrawa. The film also deals with the faith of one tank crew, which fights on the most difficult terrain covered by the Czechoslovak Independent Brigade. The destiny of the tank commander, sergeant Juraj Klimke was followed during the bloody battle at Dukla. Juraj shows that his harshness is only a mask and that he is in fact a shy and sensitive person. Battle scenes in the film were enacted by 3000 members of Czechoslovak Army.

Title: 599. El curandero
description: A doctor arrives in a small, provincial town and must pose as a healer to gain the trust of its inhabitants.

Title: 600. Tant qu'il y aura des femmes
description: A man of of principle leads a double life:one for his mistress and one he takes home to his wife.

Title: 601. The Woman for Joe
description: A sideshow owner and his main attraction, a person with dwarfism, fall for the same woman.

Title: 602. Till We Meet Again
description: Sonejiro sacrifices all comfort to devote himself to research. Young housewife Yachiyo is disappointed with her husband Kappei, who is more attracted to mountain climbing and another girl. When Yachiyo's father is introduced to Sonejiro, good will turns evil, and all happiness is at stake.

Title: 605. Days and Nights
description: A broken marriage that was caused by a drunken father. A mother was forced to raise her son with another man who also has a son. Days and nights went past and they grew up, they were different kind of step brothers. When one brother was driving drunk had hit and run accident. An innocent person who was a friend got the blame. So father decided to protect his own son who was guilty. The mother doesn't want her own innocent son to suffer. The young man decided to find his own lost drunken father to fight for him.

Title: 606. The Last Man
description: Niddy is the paternal Niece of the deceased Owner of the Hotel Hovelmann, She lives in the Hotel and is watched over by Karl, a kindly, father figure, who is a long time Servant and friend to the family and Mother. Her Cousin Alwin shows up and She eventually falls in love with him Alwin wants to eliminate Karl who interferes with his plans to convince Her to marry him. Niddy is guaranteed a place to live in the Hotel and Karl is guaranteed a job there, a common deal in that Era. Niddy fall for Alwin. Karl stops Alwin once, because he can not be fired, He is "degraded" to supervision of the washroom. He quits,and later meets Till, a Ten year old House-Boy from the Hotel while sitting in the Park. He takes Karl home and there, Karl decides to return to the Hotel and take the Job as Bathroom Attendant. There he meets his old Friend Claasen, the owner of a whole Hotel Chain. Claasen buys the "Hövelmann". Hotel, and Cousin Alwin and His plans are destroyed by Karl.

Title: 607. Sigarah wa kas
description: Hoda is a famous dancer who gives up the spotlight to marry and start a family with Mamdouh, a handsome young doctor who is just beginning his career. When Mamdouh's scheming Italian head nurse Yolanda sets her sights on Mamdouh, Hoda's jealousy drives her to drink, ultimately endangering everything she holds dear. An enchanting example of Egyptian melodrama at its finest.

Title: 608. Los tres Villalobos
description: Three cowboy brothers even fight crime.

Title: 609. Keisatsu nikki
description: The local Fukushima constabulary has a policeman who sees himself as part of the community. He does a lot more than just policing. A policeman finds an infant and a child near his station. He tries to offload them at every known agency and responsible body, but does not have success. Perhaps he can take care of them himself?

Title: 610. Hemsöborna
description: The widow Anna Eva Flod at Hemsö needs help on the farm and hire the new boy Carlsson, who quickly wins the heart of Anna Eva.

Title: 611. M'sieur la Caille
description: Pepe la Vache, who coveted Fernande's love, denounced her protector: Dominique le Corse, who was arrested. But Fernande was attracted by Jesus the Quail, a guy of dubious manners. Intimidated by Pepe, the Quail moved away.

Title: 612. Canyon Crossroads
description: A modern-day uranium prospector recruits a geology professor and his daughter to seek the "mother lode" in Utah. A sinister mine owner sends helicopters into Utah flats to stop them. The prospector's only defense--a six-shooter.

Title: 613. Murder on Approval
description: After buying a rare stamp in London, a rich American starts suspecting that the stamp is fake and hires a P.I. to investigate.

Title: 614. Mad at the World
description: The infant baby of Sam and Anne Bennett is critically hurt after being hit by a bottle thrown by a gang of juvenile delinquent hoodlums known as the Wolf Pack. Police Detective Tom Lynn takes charge of the investigation and orders a shakedown of youth gangs in Chicago's toughest section, but this fails to locate members of the Wolf Pack gang. A savage beating is given to an innocent witness by Bennett, who takes matters into his own hands in the belief that the law authorities are too slow.

Title: 615. La madone des sleepings
description: The main occupation of the beautiful Lady Diana Winham is to travel through Europe in luxury trains. She also owns a uranium mine that is of interest to many people.

Title: 616. Flottans muntergökar
description: Bob and Bernard serve as lieutenants on a cruiser.

Title: 617. Guerrillas on the Plain
description: A guerrilla group around Li Xiangyang are ambushed by the Japanese invasion army during the War of Resistance.

Title: 618. It Happens in Roma
description: Renata and Carlo covet the same apartment in Rome. They quarrel at first, but Carlo finds an original way out: what if they married and shared the place? Renata agrees, on one condition: she should be allowed to keep trying to find the man of her dreams. For a while suitors follow each other, each time ridiculed by Carlo. Things get harder with Dino, a more serious rival. After dallying with the charming young man, Renata winds up realizing that it is Carlo she really loves.

Title: 619. Piagol
description: A group of communist guerillas encounter jealousy and rivalry among themselves because of the presence of the female compatriot while one of their members plots to desert their band

Title: 620. Le signorine dello 04
description: The lives and loves of five Italian telephone operators. One is betrayed by her husband, one helps a student who wants to take his life, one changes her boyfriend every other day, one is a single mother and the last one tries to inflame a recent-widower accountant.

Title: 621. Cuando los duendes cazan perdices
description: A very humble couple celebrates the birth of their second child when accidentally kill their father that same day. The mother is forced to move and be employed as a domestic, having to give the newborn child to the marriage that used until then, leaving for Europe for a couple of years.

Title: 622. Le diciottenni
description: Love and jealousy in a female public school. Most of the co-eds are in love with professor La Rovere. One, Anna, accuses Maria to have an affair with him.

Title: 623. Tre finder en kro
description: A lawyer, a poet and a sardine rep arrive same day at a village inn. A young man arrives to take over the family estate near the village. He's interested in the innkeeper's daughter but her dad is opposed.

Title: 624. Le pain vivant
description: Thérèse is Catholic and melancholic. Her life is not happy between an austere father and an unpleasant brother: religion offers her some compensation. She will also thwart the love she feels for Valmy even though he is an atheist. The intransigent father pushes his daughter to break up. Thérèse goes on retreat to La Salette. Valmy, warned, joins her. In the alpine setting conducive to escapes and pursuits, the lovers will be defeated. One will yield, the other will be enlightened by the Holy Spirit.

Title: 625. Our Director
description: Over at the fictional DRGBP institution, events take a settling turn after a mutinied prize festivity.

Title: 626. Kanyasulkam
description: Kanyasulkam is an adaptation of the popular Telugu play of same title. The film deals with prejudices of contemporary Indian society such as child marriages.

Title: 627. Blekitny krzyz
description: It's February 1945. A Polish rescue team sets out to bring back the wounded Soviet and Slovak partisans who are trapped behind the mountain border as well as behind enemy lines.

Title: 628. Pesma sa Kumbare
description: Story of the revolt of the people of Serbia against the Turks, who ruled the country for four centuries. The battle and the fall of the fortress of Belgrade in 1806.

Title: 629. Åsa-Nisse ordnar allt
description: Åsa-Nisse has a bad back and when he visits the doctor he gets an experimental medicine for horses by mistake. Suddenly Åsa-Nisse has super strengths and becomes an unbeatable athlete.

Title: 630. Two Grooms for a Bride
description: A money-to-burn and girl-chasing Texas oilman and a sensitive, dignified entomologist find themselves together in Winchester, England charged with taking care of a brood of wild kids.

Title: 631. The Last Paradise
description: A 1955 Italian independent film released in the USA in 1956, which is basically a travelogue telling four stories, each about a different island in the South Pacific. Native customs, tribal rites, ceremonial procedure, courtships and feats of strength and courage are depicted. The test of courage for males on one island, is a leap from a high wooden tower to the ground with a thin vine wrapped around their ankles breaking the fall at the last minute. The first bungee-jumpers?

Title: 632. Air Strike
description: A Navy Commander tries to mold a jet-fighter attack squadron into an efficient fighting machine.

Title: 634. Garam Coat
description: Girdharilal lives a poor lifestyle in Delhi along with his wife, Geeta, and two daughters and a son. He works as a Money Order Clerk in the Post Office, earns Rs.110/- per Mensem, and wears a torn coat that his wife is tired of stitching. One day at work, he makes an error in a money order but does manage to fix it, collects his pay and returns home, refusing to drink alcohol with his co-workers, Sher Khan and Munnilal. He then sets out to buy some snacks and toys for his children and loses a 100 Rupee note. Unable to recollect where he lost it, he decides to kill himself but when he misses the train he returns home and confides in his wife. She assures him that she will manage somehow. He manages to borrow money, even finds a part-time job, to pay off his bills, but is unable to pay his electricity bill. One night he returns home and finds the pantry full. His mind distracted with doubts about his wife's character, he starts making mistakes at both his places of employment, and returns home to find his door locked, his wife missing, and his children playing outside. When he questions them about the whereabouts of their mother, they refuse to tell him. Shortly thereafter Sher Khan and Munnilal, concerned about their co-worker, find him near the railway tracks heading straight into an on-coming train. Sher manages to rescue him, and this is when he will tell them the devastating news that Geeta has taken to prostitution and he has killed her. Watch what impact this has on his employment, his children, and his friends.

Title: 635. Outlaw Treasure
description: After two outlaw gangs team up to rob gold shipments, the U.S. Army sends their ace troubleshooter Dan Parker, to the area. Sam Casey, the mystery man behind the gangs, kills Parker's father, and this induces his sweetheart Rita Starr, to side with the law and order faction. An attempt by Casey to kill Rita is foiled by Parker, which leads to a widespread gun-battle.

Title: 636. The Impossible Mr. Pipelet
description: Maurice Martin takes care of the concierge's lodge he has with his wife, the amiable Germaine.

Title: 637. Cinderella
description: "Cinderella" is a delightful musical version of the classic fairytale of a good-natured girl and her wicked stepmother. When the local prince holds a ball for all the women in the land so he can find a wife, Cinderella is forbidden to go. With the aid of her good fairy godmother, however, Cinderella attends the ball and wins the prince's heart. Filmed in a beautiful natural setting, this charming tale of rewards of virtue is excellent for family viewing.

Title: 638. Puss 'n Boots
description: When a poor miller died, his son inherited nothing but his beloved cat and was thrown out of the mill by his older brother. He was dejected and at a loss as to what to do now, when, to his astonishment, the cat suddenly began to speak.

Title: 639. El hombre que debía una muerte
description: A young woman receives a stranger in her home who has an accident, they both get married and she inherits a fortune due to the death of her uncle. Later, she will discover that there is a connection between the events.

Title: 640. Italia K2
description: After the successful conquest of Everest in 1953, two Italians reach the summit of K2, the second highest mountain in the world, the next year,after careful preparation and the formation of the team of climbers, scientists, and porters.

Title: 642. It Happened on July 20th
description: A dramatic reconstruction of the July 1944 attempt by German Army Officers to assassinate Hitler with a bomb and end the war before Germany was totally destroyed.

Title: 643. Nosotros dos
description: After the death of her husband, Francisca Pedrosa returns to her home village along with María, her daughter. However, an ancient irreconcilable enmity pits the Pedrosas against another family in the town, the Avilés. Which does not prevent María and Beto, the youngest of the Avilés brothers, from falling madly in love, giving rise to the anger of his father and Lupo, the older brother. As if they were a new Romeo and Juliet, María and Beto will do everything possible to move forward with their relationship.

Title: 645. Police Cordon
description: A group of robbers assault a factory in the port of Barcelona, but, upon being discovered, they are forced to flee hastily, each one his own way. An exhaustive police device is then initiated with the aim of capturing them. But the police persecution to which the members of the gang are subjected incites distrust between them and, one after another, they will fall, until only two remain.

Title: 646. Kundan
description: Les Miiserables--originally French film later adapted to English.

Title: 647. Cross Channel
description: Charter-boat owner "Tex" Parker is framed on a murder rap by a gang of jewel-and-American currency smugglers operating from the coasts of England and France, with a mid-channel rendezvous. The smugglers use him, his boat and partner, "Soapy", to carry their goods back and forth across the English. During one of the trips, "Tex" is thrown overboard, but is picked up by a French fishing boat and the fisherman take him back to their village, Porte Soliare, where he meets Jacqueline. People who appear to be quite dead early on turn out to be not dead later on, and money and swag and goods keep changing hands with such regularity that, at one point, one guy is searching for something he already has (and doesn't know it), while another guy isn't searching for it because he thinks he has it...but doesn't.

Title: 648. Bara-Dari
description: According to the astrologer, the king's son seeing his father before the age of eight or drinking breast milk from his own mother until the age of eight is a danger to the son. So a widow whose husband was beheaded by the king raises her son and the king's son until he is eight years old. Although the two boys grow up and live separately, fate makes them both fall in love with the same girl.

Title: 649. Oshun torimonochô - Nazo no ama goten
651. Children Galore
description: The Joneses compete for a cottage offered by a British lord to the couple with the most grandchildren.

Title: 652. Krushenie emirata
description: 1920 Western countries are attempting to use the Khanate of Bukhara, a former protectorate of Tsarist Russia, to fight Soviet power. M.V. Frunze and V.V. Kuibyshev, who arrived in Tashkent, organize the masses to fight counter-revolutionaries and foreign intelligence agents.

Title: 654. I pappagalli
description: Sunday is the only day off that house maids use to date the young men who cross their paths: doormen, soldiers, sailors, timid virgins and lurid husbands, or even a doctor.

Title: 655. Fortune carrée
description: Literary adaptation of an adventure from the 30s: An escaped convict from a Middle East conflict sneaks onto a French craft loaded with weapons for sale, which encounters a storm on the Red Sea.

Title: 656. Beside Murder
description: A ship has sunk;insurance premium: a hundred million Francs.

Title: 659. Bahr el gharam
description: Touna [Naima Akef] and Amin [Rushdy Abaza] were sweethearts in Damietta in a fishing compound owned by their two fathers. They loved the constant clear skies and the pure waters and each became angry and jealous when perceiving the other interacting casually with a member of the opposite gender. Amin's boat was caught in a storm and he was badly injured. A theater director [Youssef Wahby] recognized Touna's talent and offered her work as a performer, so she went to Cairo and became a showgirl so she could pay Amin's costly medical expenses at a Cairo hospital.

Title: 661. Our Best Days
description: Poor girl live on the surface next to the three poor young people fall in love with her all and discover they occur under the weight of the disease, which would be required to hold surgery, everyone rush to help her for the surgery. See who is going to help her? You will fall in love with him?

Title: 662. Uli, der Pächter
description: Uli, the tenant on the 'Glunggenhof', leads a happy life with his wife and child. Weather luck and honest work bring him rich harvests, and so he becomes overconfident and, advised by false friends, gets entangled in unclean business.

Title: 664. Salna pavasari
description: End of 19th century. Maidservant Madara loves farmhand Andris but due to the property she marries a rich and old household owner Migla.

Title: 667. Dakilang hudas
description: With a gun in his hand he's dangerous to love, more dangerous to hate.

Title: 668. Ôkami
description: A few years after the surrender of Japan in the Second World War, the country is in ruins, the economy devastated, and the vulnerable masses deprived of work; let alone the basic amenities of life.
