A new order, led by voracious opportunists is in the make where the weak are easy prey to the hydra-headed mountebanks. Betrayed and exploited by their employer, a group of five trainee insurance brokers face the challenge of commuting suicide, or taking the path of felony. They choose the latter and decide to rub a money truck to ease the suffering and pain of their family members.

Title: 669. Un extraño en la escalera
description: A mistreated manager plans to kill his boss with the help of the new secretary.

Title: 670. Ragazze d'oggi
description: Peppino Bardellotti, a widower, lives in Milan with his four daughters and ex sister-in-law Matilde, who urges girls to settle down by marrying a wealthy man.

Title: 671. Blændværk
description: This noir drama has a double plot. A political thriller about sabotage on NATO transports. And a steamy love story with 19 y.o. Mimi Henrich showing all. First ever nude exposure in a Danish feature movie (causing quite a stir in its day).

Title: 672. Der Kongreß tanzt
description: Congress of Vienna, 1815. In order to lure certain monarchs away from the conference, the Austrians instigate a ceaseless sequence of operas and balls. Indeed, Russian Czar Alexander is distracted when he falls for a beautiful salesgirl.

Title: 673. Amanat
description: A dying man entrusts his lives earnings to Purshotam, a stranger he just met, and asks him to promise to take this money to his wife, and son, Pradeep, in a remote village in India, to which Purshotam agrees. The man passes away, and Purshotam goes to fulfill his promise, in vain though, as he is unable to trace the woman and her son. After sometime he experiences financial difficluties, and decides to use the money for his personal gain. Years later he comes to know of the rightful heir to these monies, but will he able to assert his honesty, or will he carry on as though nothing has happened?

Title: 674. Flowers of Our Motherland
description: 2 students become members of the Young Pioneers.

Title: 677. Zaczarowany rower
description: Staszek Popiel is the star of the Polish cycling team. Unfortunately, he pays more attention to his own career than to team fights. The athlete hides his injury from his friends and, as a result, the Polish team does not do very well in an important race. As part of his strategy, the cyclist intends to damage the bike of his most dangerous rival, a Hungarian named Haranda.

Title: 680. El malvado Carabel
description: Amaro Carabel, about to get married, asks for a salary increase that gets him fired. He then decides to stop being an honest man so as to not end up single.

Title: 682. Night Freight
description: A railroad man finds himself at war with a trucker bent on blasting him out of business.

Title: 683. Crèvecoeur
description: Garcet, a young French officer just out of military school, joins the French Batallion of the United Nations Forces fighting in Korea. He is disappointed at first as he is assigned as liasion officer behind the lines. Later he is given a combat command. There, he has to win the loyality and frienship of his fellow officers and the men. Although all are volunteers, many are puzzled as to just what it is they are fighting for in this remote and desolate corner of the world: The cast of "Heartbreak Ridge" is composed of Officers and Enlisted men who fought with the French Batallion under the flag of the United Nations in Korea. Made under the sponsorship of the French Ministry of National Defense with the co-operation of the Officers, non-commissioned Officers and Enlisted men in the volunteer French Batallion.

Title: 685. Niña bonita
description: She's naughty. She's capricious. She's lovely and lovable: Niña Bonita.

Title: 687. The Girl and the Oak
description: Smilja is a little girl living in Dalmatian Zagora. One day, her mother dies under a small oak tree and she is left without parents. Luckily, she gets adopted and continues to nurture the oak where her mother died. Many years later, Smilja is a handsome woman, but her jealous stepbrother Josip kills her boyfriend Ivan and rapes her. Ivan's brothers swear revenge.

Title: 688. Le village magique
description: A young Parisian plans a holiday in Sicily with his new fiancee but has to take a later train, without her, because of work obligations.

Title: 690. No Place to Hide
description: Some pellets containing a deadly virus are carried by two boys on the run through the Philippines.

Title: 691. Heroes of Shipka
description: Epic historical drama. The Russo - Turkish War of Liberation of 1878 and the role of the Bulgarian Volunteer Gorps.

Title: 692. Accadde al penitenziario
description: A prison warden keeps a diary in which he writes about the convicts he meets and their lives.

Title: 693. Jochûkko
description: In order to pay back Mrs. Kajiki for her good deed in the past, Hatsu moves from her village in Akita to Tokyo to start working as a maid for her family. She grows close to their youngest son Katsumi, experiencing things that will change her view on life.

Title: 694. Anarkali
description: Salim, the son of the emperor Akbar loves Anarkali. But Akbar refuses to accept their relationship. So misunderstandings arises between Akbar and Salim.

Title: 695. Bandish
description: Mahender has been responsible for the upbringing of Tomato, a young child at a very early age. Now Mahender's health is getting worse, and he is afraid his ill-health may be contagious and may endanger Tomato. So Mahender decides to leave Tomato in the park near Kamal Roy, and instructs Tomato to call Kamal his dad. Tomato does so, and this results in utter chaos in the life of Kamal. He is unable to convince his lady love Usha Sen that the child is not his; and additionally Kamal is under pressure from his dad and mom to get married. Kamal begs Tomato to leave him, but Tomato refuses to do so. How will this impact on Kamal's life and relationships?

Title: 696. As Long as You Live
description: Amidst the chaos of the Spanish Civil War, a nurse tends to a wounded pilot.

Title: 697. No Time for Tears
description: Coach Shimamura of the hapless Sparrows baseball team is pleased to obtain a hot new pitcher named Onishi. But when Onishi begins a romantic relationship with the coach's daughter Michiko, Shimamura becomes angry with the young man, lashing out at him when he disobeys instructions during a game. In turn, Michiko becomes angry with her father, who becomes increasingly depressed. When a tragedy strikes the family, Coach Shimamura begins losing control of his life, just when his family and his team need him most.

Title: 698. L'ultimo amante
description: Maria, a prostitute, meets Cesare in a police station, a drunkard reporter. Cesare falls in love with her and wants to save her from her bleak life but the girl refuses any help.

Title: 699. The Stolen Airliner
description: Three air cadets foil criminals who are plotting to steal an airliner.

Title: 702. The Corsican Brothers
description: A man dies in a duel and his twin brother arrives from Corsica, and falls in love with the same woman his brother loved. He also joins a conspiracy in which his dead brother was involved.

Title: 703. El conde de Monte Carlo
description: Steeped with suspense, excitement and thrills never before seen in a single movie.

Title: 704. Ghamand
description: Ghamand is a story that revolves around a gangster who searches for a groom for his daughter. A married doctor treats the gangster's daughter for an illness. The story takes a turn when gangster's daughter runs away with the doctor, although her father arranges her marriage to someone else.

Title: 705. Windfall
description: A shop assistant finds a case with £2000 in it, and doesn't quite know what to do with it.

Title: 706. Le printemps, l'automne et l'amour
description: Fernand Sarrasin, nicknamed Noël, is a nougat manufacturer in his fifties who lives an uneventful life in Montélimar. One day he saves a young girl called Cécilia from drowning and falls in love with her. He persuades her to marry him despite their difference in age. Unfortunately Julie, Noël's jealous and spiteful sister-in-law, does her utmost to separate him from Cécilia. She even goes as far as to throw Noël's young wife into the arms of a playboy pianist, Jean Balestra. Both leave for Paris and Noël is heart-broken...

Title: 708. Interdit de séjour
description: An outcast everywhere ,particularly in the normal world in which he used to live in , a naive young man tries to find some help in the underworld .

Title: 709. Ebediyete kadar
description: A woman in pursuit of her whims.

Title: 710. The Lowest Crime
description: semi-documentary police officer about a criminal organization specializing in blackmail.

Title: 711. Mau-Mau
description: Newsman Chet Huntley narrates this documentary showing the rise of the African resistance movement known as the "Mau-Mau" against British rule in East Africa in the early 1950s.

Title: 715. Der Struwwelpeter
description: A live action adaptation of the 1845 children's book.

Title: 716. Cortile
description: A teenager escapes from a reformatory and is accused of theft.

Title: 718. Rojulu Marayi
description: A landlord cheats people in a village and grabs their lands. A young man reveals the landlord's true colors before everyone. So he creates differences between the young man and his wife. But they overcome all the misunderstandings.

Title: 719. Ayer fue primavera
description: A man suspects that his late wife had an extramarital relationship, so he decides to face the alleged lover.

Title: 720. El túnel 6
description: A digging crew excavating a tunnel through a huge mountain, are cut off and trapped by a rockfall and landslide.

Title: 721. Dev Anand in Goa (Alias Farar)
description: A group of freedom-fighters face betrayal and go on the run from police in British-occupied Hindustan.

Title: 723. Liebe ist ja nur ein Märchen
description: A girl comes back to Greece where she meets again her papa ,an eminent scientist,her fiance (daddy's right-hand man) ,her nanny who occasionally mends broken hearts,and the professor's collaborator.

Title: 726. El juramento de Lagardere
description: Disguised as a hunchback, French knight Henri de Lagardere plots revenge for the death of a friend and pursues a romance with the fallen man's widow.

Title: 728. Destinazione Piovarolo
description: Antonio La Quaglia becomes the railroader in Piovarolo during 1922 meanwhile the fascism is raising. Later he marries a jewish woman. He has career ambitions but can not reach them.

Title: 729. Mercado de abasto
description: The action occurs in Abasto Market in Buenos Aires, Argentina. A grown up single woman marries a mafia man who promised her he would change. After they've married, the past come to ruin the wife's life.

Title: 730. Battal Gazi Geliyor
description: The story of Battal Gazi, who is trying to avenge his father.

Title: 731. Die Drei von der Tankstelle
description: Three friends buy a gas station together and work separate shifts. They all fall in love with a customer, not realizing it's the same woman.

Title: 732. More studyonoye
description: XVIII century, the White Sea. The crew of the Pomors is going to fish. During their stay on Svalbard, pirates attack the boat and lower it to the bottom. Only four Pomors survive on the island and spend difficult 6 years there.

Title: 734. Urlaub auf Ehrenwort
description: Four soldiers awaiting transport to the front are allowed, on their word of honor, a layover of some hours in the city and resist temptations for romance and political agitation.

Title: 735. Drei Tage Mittelarrest
description: Grete, the mayor's maid, has an illegitimate son and claims the father is a private from the local garrison. The mayor requests the commander to identify the culprit. The investigation fails. Already Grete has set her eyes on someone else.

Title: 736. Three in One
description: This film contains three short stories about life in Australia in the 1950's.

Title: 737. El guardián del paraíso
description: A night watchman tells of his adventures with a poet in love, a nun trying to get a medicine and a robbery attempt.

Title: 738. Seine Tochter ist der Peter
description: Engineer Max Klaar raises his tomboy daughter Elisabeth (nicknamed Peter) alone. Nora Christian, a famous actress and Max's ex-wife, resurfaces in the village where father and daughter live. Elisabeth coming across her mother takes her to Max's house. Shortly afterward, Elisabeth nearly drowns herself in the village lake but is saved at the last minute by Helga, a student vacationing in the area. The latter is not immune to the charms of Max but Nora puts an end to the fledgling romance by going away and taking Elisabeth with her. Max is at a loss... but not for long. Elisabeth soon realizes she needs her two parents and manages to reunite them in the end.

Title: 740. Pas de coup dur pour Johnny
description: Robert Lanier, a man with a doubtful past, disembarks clandestinely in Le Havre decided to rebuild his life. Johnny, an orphaned young acrobat, takes him for his father and presents him to the seductive Gaby, his best friend.

Title: 746. Born for Trouble
description: Joan Shawlee, the redhead star, plays Aggie Anderson, an American fashion scout who has a genius for getting into trouble. She finds herself involved in several exciting adventures in Paris, Berlin and London.

Title: 747. Madh Bhare Nain
description: Shyam flees to Darljeeling when his family begins battling each other over who the young man should marry. During the train trip he falls in love with Malti, not realizing she is one of the girls his family has chosen.

Title: 749. Yangsan Province
description: Two lovers are forced into suicide as the only way to maintain their forbidden love.

Title: 750. Lazni car
description: An historical film based on the struggle of the Montenegrians for their independence.

Title: 751. Zalacaín el aventurero
description: At the end of his life, the famous novelist Pío Baroja recalls the stunning facts that led him to write the story of Zalacaín, a brave young man who lived in the basque mountains in the 19th century.

Title: 752. Der Hauptmann und sein Held
description: A post WWII German satire of the stupidity of a military culture so often associated with that country: An intellectual, civilian type totally unsuited for the army mentality somehow lands up playing the role, to the hilt, of a hero.

Title: 753. Gul-E-Bakavali
description: The adventures of a prince to achieve a magical flower to bring back his father's vision.

Title: 754. El canto del gallo
description: A priest in a communist country tries to escape denying his religious condition.

Title: 755. Vatertag
description: The driving instructor Gustav Helbig is satisfied with himself, because he got his "hardest case" to date, the hairdresser Egon Kammerhahn, through the driving test. However, Mrs. Berta Helbig is dissatisfied, as she urgently wants to go into town to do important errands. This also includes a visit to Thea and Paul Brause's dog grooming salon, which is booming because every third inhabitant of the town owns a dog. Thea takes care of the beauty of the animals while her husband trains them. In marriage it is exactly the opposite, because here Paul is on a leash.

Title: 756. La Madelon
description: 1914:"Le Tourlourou" is a cafe in Ganchery .La Madelon is the owner's daughter.She's in love with a corporal ,but she likes all these soldiers who go back to fight.

Title: 758. Escape from Terror
description: A couple who have escaped from the Baltics to Copenhagen are pursued by a KGB officer.

Title: 760. Mangayar Thilakam
description:
The story starts with the special birthday celebration of a girl. Vasudevan (Sivaji Ganesan) narrates the story which goes back 14 years behind. Karunakaran (S. V. Subbaiah) and Vasudevan (Master Baji) are brothers whose parents had died. They are very much loving and close to each other but Vasudevan longs for mother's love.

Much to the relatives persuasion, Karunakaran accepts to marry Sulochana (Padmini). Vasudevan gets angry as he is notified regarding this and would accept not this wedding to take place if he does not like the bride. He sets off to the bride's house and he likes her at the first glimpse. The wedding takes place and Sulochana becomes a loving and passionate wife as well as sister-in-law. Vasudevan treats and accepts her as his own mother. Meanwhile, Sulochana gets pregnant and deliveres a baby boy but the baby dies soon after.

Time rolls on and Vasudevan becomes as an adult and becomes a college professor but unfortunately Karunakaran and Sulochana was not blessed with children. Vasudevan presents Sulochana gold bangles from his first pay. Vasudevan was arranged to marry Rao Bahadur Ponnambalam's (K. Sarangkapani) and Akilam's (K. N. Kamalam) daughter Prabha (M. N. Rajam).

Comic relief was presented in a moral story of Ponnambalam's family. Ponnambalam listens too much to and often quarrels with Akilam. This drives Ponnambalam's son Kalamani (K. A. Thangavelu) and his wife Neela (Ragini) to hatch a drama in order for Ponnambalam and Akilam to be united and respect each other. Kalamani and Neela succeeds in this.

Prabha's character was the opposite of Sulochana's but the latter least bother about this and carries on her daily good deeds. Prabha gets pregnant and deliveres a baby boy, Ravi (Master Ravi) but she does not care much for him. Sulochana picks up the tasks and takes care of Ravi as a mother should be of. As Ravi grows, Prabha does not like this and forbids Sulochana from raising Ravi.

Ravi falls ill due to the separation and Sulochana takes care of him day and night not bothering her meals and health. Ravi becomes very serious for a month till the doctor who treats him lose hope. Sulochana takes Ravi to a temple and pleads to Lord Shiva to take her life instead and spare Ravi's life. Prabha apologises to Sulochana but the latter says that it was by the God's grace before collapsing due to being too weak. Even in death bed, Sulochana enquires about Ravi's health. After thanking Karunakaran and Vasudevan for a good life as a daughter-in-law in the house and says that she would be reborn in this house, Sulochana dies.

Sulochana's body was cremated but Karunakaran and Vasudevan were surprised to see the gold bangles were not damaged during the process. A baby girl was born on the exact day after a year and she was accepted by the whole family as Sulochana reborn. The gold bangles would be worn to her on every birthday thus the special occasion.

Title: 761. The Human Clay
description: A marital conflict comes to court and becomes public comment.

Title: 762. Lourdes et ses miracles
description: A triptych of three short subjects on the town in the Pyrenees famous for its cult of the French Saint Bernadette and for its supposed miracle cures of the faithful who travel there on pilgrimage.

Title: 765. Suor Maria
description: Carmela becomes a nun after her father's death. She has no vocation but wants to escape from Mario a no-gooder who has set his eyes on her. Stefano, a good guy, is in love with her and is ready to wait for her.

Title: 766. Casse-cou, mademoiselle!
description: Working for a stock-car team, Robert dreams of becoming a racing driver himself. For a long time this is only a pipe dream until one day fortune smiles on him when he saves the life of a young woman. Gisèle, the young lady in question, happens to be the daughter of a car manufacturer. Robert and Gisèle fall for each other and decide to marry. They get on quite well except on one point: Gisèle does not want her husband to take part in car races. But passion is the strongest and, breaking the ban, Gilbert wins the La Baule car event. Overcoming her aversion, Gisèle finally allows her husband to pursue his brilliant career.

Title: 767. Handcuffs, London
description: A man finds a rare stamp and takes it to an expert to find out what it's worth. He discovers it is a forgery and starts to find out who is behind it.

Title: 768. Mambo-dyambo
description: Thrill upon thrill awaits you as the mysterious, mystic statue from India comes to life in this new and daringly different fantasy-comedy.

Title: 769. Il cantante misterioso
description: Some time ago, Luciano was wrongly accused by the woman he loved and sent to jail. One day he manages to escape from prison but is seriously wounded. Found by a gang of smugglers, he is taken by one of them, Paolo, to the house of Pietro, an old fisherman who lives with niece Marina, Paolo's fiancée. Thanks to their care, Luciano recovers although his legs remain paralyzed. Not knowing how to thank them both, Luciano decides to help them financially by going to sing at the village's inn. Gennaro, the local organist, who has composed a song for him, records it and sends it to the RAI, where a song contest is organized. Luciano is awarded the first prize but, as he is still wanted by the police, he can't reveal his identity. He has become the"Mysterious Singer"...

Title: 770. María la Voz
description: In rural America, a psychic finds herself caught between warring families while competing with her closest friend for the same man's affections.

Title: 773. Kiinni on ja pysyy
description: Pekka and Pätkä attempt to make a living as inventors. Accidentally they get involved in a bank robbery.

Title: 774. Rakas lurjus
description: It is a time of extreme housing shortage in Helsinki. People with room in their flats are required either to find subtenants or to lodge anyone sent by the housing commission. Abel and Jussi Siimes, two devoted haters of women, find themselves in this predicament. They need to find a subtenant quickly to avoid the possibility of the housing commission sending a woman, God forbid it, to live with them. Abel's acquaintance, an assessor, recommends his nephew Kaino as the perfect choice. Of course, the nephew is a niece...

Title: 776. Penarek Beca
description: A rich man's daughter falls in love with a poor trishaw rider. Her father fiercely disapproves their relationship and he goes all out to break them apart. Love triumphs in the end when it is proven that not all rich people are good ones.

Title: 778. Trevozhnaya molodost
description: Childhood and youth of a group of Ukrainians born in the turbulent 1920s

Title: 779. Kankabatir Ghat
description: A tragic story depicting and highlighting the disastrous destiny of the ethnic, eternal Indian woman 'Kangkabotir Ghat' is about the banks of river Ganga in the village of Atashi from where Sati Kangkabati, the great wife of Mr. Mukherji an artist, committed suicide in an eternal ritual fashion to save her ailing and dying husband. The legend here emphasises that if the wife sacrifices her life in the waters of Ganga, then the husband would revive. After Kangka bati commits suicide, the eccentric Mr. Mukherjee turns mad out of shock and grief and leaves the village with their infant daughter Uma who is latter abducted by the shrewd escort Chameli. Uma grous up under Chameli's parentage, under the name of Sheela, while all the years the insane Mukherjee goes searching for Uma, not realizing that his daughter is in front of his very own eyes. Sheela alias Uma fall in love with Pradip but abandons ? has when a misunderstanding consciously created by Chameli arises. Later a pregnant Uma leaves Chameli and starts residing separately with Mr. Mukherjee which ? Pradip marries for the second time. His second wife is Mrinaal. Co-incidentally Pradip, Mrinal, the rest are also from the same village of Atashi and thus respect Kangkabati's sacrifice immensely. Pradip and Uma meet after 7 long years through Pradip-Uma's enstranged son. Pradip is shocked to see Uma's poverty & his own son doing hawkery in the lanes of Kolkata. After returning to Atashi, he falls severely sick and ultimately marches towards death. Meanwhile in Kolkata, amidst all formalist. The real truth is revealed by Nandua, an ally of Chameli and Mr. Mukherjee and Uma realizes that they are the father daughter in reality. The father daughter duo gets the news about Pradip's sickness. Uma runs to save the life of her husband who is now somebody else's husband. She meets her rival Mrinaal with almost compassion, keeps her son at her refuge and follows the same path of her mother Kangkabati to save the life of he

Title: 781. Phantom of the Jungle
description: Three episodes (40,41,42) of the TV series "Ramar of the Jungle" edited together and released as a feature.

Title: 786. Suonno d'ammore
description: Alberto loves Maria, daughter of Arturo, a rich owner of boats, his love is reciprocated by the girl and has the approval of her father.

Title: 787. Marta
description: Since time immemorial, stretching back several generations, a deep-seated hatred has existed between two of Barcelona's wealthiest bourgeois families: the Balmers and the Lafuentes. Marta, the kind-hearted daughter of Don Rufino Balmer, returns home after years in a convent and attempts reconciliation, but love affairs, fights, and jealous murders ensue.

Title: 793. Seido no Kirisuto
description: Christian converts face persecution in the feudal society of 17th century Japan.

Title: 796. Far til fire på landet
description: The little family is discussing where to go on summer vacation. At last the family decides to travel to the danish countryside in Jutland

Title: 797. Adventures of Captain Africa: Mighty Jungle Avenger!
description: Trapper Nat Coleman and government agent Ted Arnold come upon a plot to take over an African nation. Its leader, Caliph Abdul el Hamid, has been exiled from his country and replaced by a look-alike usurper allied with an unnamed foreign power. The Caliph intends to return but enemy agents Boris and Greg are out to stop him. Captain Africa a masked jungle lord, appears occasionally to aid Nat and Ted.

Title: 799. Görüs
description: It is about azerbaijani and uzbek cotton-growers who compete each other. Uzbek girl Lala and Azerbaijani boy Kamil's love is the bottom line of the film.

Title: 803. La hermana alegría
description: Soledad enters a reforming school where good-humored sister Consolación with her extravagant methods wins her confidence. She then confesses the truth and they will try to make things right.

Title: 804. Red Skelton Christmas Classics (in Color)
description: Beloved funnyman Red Skelton weaves his Christmas magic in this classic collection of the finest of his hilarious - and touching - sketches from his long-running television show. It's the ultimate Red Skelton Holiday Collection. Restored and In Color.
16 WONDERFUL SONGS AND DANCES. - SCINTILLATING DANCES. - NOT ONLY 1 - NOT ONLY 2- BUT 3 PAIRS OF YOUR FAVORITE STARS ARE IN THIS TUNEFUL MUSICAL ROMANCE.

Title: 807. Janne Vängman och den stora kometen
description: Janne Vängman is having dreams of meeting aliens from outer space.

Title: 808. Kuripot
description: They teased her - they laughed at her - they scorned her - they called her all sorts of names from "MAKUNAT" to "SWAPANG".

Title: 812. Galathea - Around the world in 80 minutes
description: Documentary of the The Galathea-Expedition 2. The purpose was partly scientific (deep-sea research, Hydrographic and Earth Magnetism measurements), partly promoting Danish Culture and Business in the planned countries of arrival.

Title: 813. Liberace's Mother's Day Special: A Vintage Show with Mr. Showmanship
description: In this classic show, Liberace celebrates Mother's Day with songs, jokes, and stories. His own Mother also appears as well.

Title: 815. Meine Kinder und ich
description: When Mutz' Hartmann's husband suddenly dies her legendary resilience is put to the test, and she enlists the brains and brawn of her three children to raise sufficient funds to keep their home and put food on the table.

Title: 816. La otra vida del capitán Contreras
description: During archaeological excavations in the crypt of Santo Tomé, Toledo (Spain), a sarcophagus is discovered that contains the uncorrupted body of Captain Contreras, a man in a state of lethargy since 1650, due to a potion that someone forced him to ingest to avoid ills greater. The cheeky journalist Cornejo intends to take advantage of this finding, with the help of Paca Revilla, a careless woman, and an unscrupulous doctor. The controversy over the authenticity of the body of Contreras reaches the ears of some American universities, which buy the body of the Captain.

Title: 817. All in Good Fun
description: Bob Monkhouse introduces comedy clips from the early days of cinema.

Title: 818. Condemned Even by Her Own Child
description: The well-hidden past of his widowed mother prevents a young man from marrying his girlfriend. When the truth comes to light, his cryptic mother reveals yet another shocking secret, one that only the girl's father knows.

Title: 819. Prince Arsalan
description: Prince Arsalan who is in love with Farrokh-Lagha travels to the west to find her. He meets the two ministers of Petros Shah. With the aids of Shams Vazir and enmity of Qamar Vazir cause him to has many adventures which finally lead to the marriage of him with Farrokh-Lagha.

Title: 823. Så tuktas kärleken
description: Per is in love with Kerstin. They are high school classmates. In the distance they see teacher Eva Hallström, PhD and the headmaster's wife, return home to her home. She is currently a major topic of conversation.

Title: 825. The Shadow That Kills the Moon
827. Den underbara lögnen
description: The night before her wedding, a nervous bride examines her gifts and picks out a book of romantic short stories. Hoping to while away the evening, she settles on the couch and begins reading "La grande Bretêche" by Honoré de Balzac.

Title: 828. Binibining kalog
description: "KALOG" is heard everywhere, it's the word on everybody's lips, but nobody knows its exact meaning. Is it SCATTERBRAIN? CRAZY? Or just plain FUNNY? Here's one HOWL-A-RI-OUS version. A story about a tomboyish girl pursuing her crush.

Title: 831. Uogashi no Ishimatsu: Nidaime Ishimatsu ooabare
834. Fukushû jôrurizaka: Dai ni bu: Akatsuki no kessen
836. Motivo in maschera
description: A presenter invents a radio quiz in which the contestants have to recognize a popular tune disguised as a classical one. Lots of people take part in the contest.

Title: 840. Edo issun no mushi
description: This historical film depicts the life of a man who was at the mercy of the waves during transition from the end of the Edo period to the Meiji Restoration, and therefore, shows audience the dynamic change from Edo to Meiji.

Title: 841. Aogashima no kodomotachi - Onna kyôshi no kiroku
843. Prashna
description: A beautiful movie of a very virtuous boy who has to face the harshness of the world due t the death of the father.But with his hard work and patience he achieves happiness in life which was lost during the bad days.

Title: 847. Red Fish
description: One night of storm, Hugo and Ivón arrive at a hotel in Gijón (Spain) accompanied by the son of the first one. They go out to see the sea raging and, shortly after, Ivón returns asking for help because the boy has been washed away by the sea. As the corpse does not appear, a commissioner takes charge of the case.

Title: 848. The Case of the Red Monkey
description: A US agent protects a defecting Russian scientist in London as scientists are murdered. The agent finds the killers' hideout, is captured with a policeman's niece, escapes, and stops the killings.

Title: 849. Espaldas mojadas
description: Mexican worker Rafael Améndola runs from the police and cross the Mexican-American border, helped by Frank Mendoza, a partner of an American called Mr. Sterling, who gives work to illegal migrants. Once in the United States, Rafael does not adapt to his new life.

Title: 850. El ojo de cristal
description: With the intention of stealing the compensation for a work accident, Enrique kills an old man. However, it turns out that he had not yet collected it, so he will try, then, to falsify the signature of the check. Meanwhile, at the same time that the police are investigating the case, the son of the police inspector investigates on his own.

Title: 851. Where Mountains Float
description: Drama documentary about the 10-year-old boy Mikisoq (Hannibal Mathiesen), who lives with his family in a remote settlement on the west coast of Greenland.

Title: 852. Mawed maa Iblis
description: Ragab is a doctor struggling with his financial life, he meets Nabil and discovers that he is the devil himself. They have a deal to make him the best doctor ever.

Title: 853. The Shiinomi School
description: Both the young sons of a professor are stricken by polio. The elder son dreams of starting a school for lame children and his father fulfills it. In the midst of an agile, outdoor daily life in this special school, one of the student dies.

Title: 854. See How They Run
description: Cockney corporal Wally Winton (Ronald Shiner) desires promotion so that he can finally receive an inheritance. He dresses up as a priest and goes out one night with Penelope Toop (Greta Gynt), the vicar's attractive blonde wife. To add to the theme of mistaken identity, there are several priests running around, some real, some fake. One of these, Basher (Charles Farrell), is discovered by Winton to be an escaped convict, and is placed under arrest. The corporal is then promoted and becomes eligible for his inheritance.

Title: 855. Buonanotte... avvocato!
description: Alberto is a mediocre lawyer, with good dialectics, but unable to win causes, even very easy. He is married to Clara, but during her absences, often involved in charity and religious pilgrimages with a high society ladies' commission, Alberto is not ashamed of attending nightclubs with his friend and colleague Vittorio and enter into distractions with other women.

Title: 856. The Tale of Jiro
description: Literary adaptation set in early 20th century Japan, in which a sensitive boy is surrounded by unloving family members.

Title: 857. Gerô no kubi
description: The tragic, bloody and unjust revenge of the young samurai Shintaro on his faithful servant, the spear-carrier Nohei, who accidentally kills his master's father.

Title: 858. Les évadés
description: During World War II, three prisoners escape from a labor camp.

Title: 859. Roman Tales
description: Alvaro is been in jail, so he consider himself the most fit to lead his three friends Mario, Otello, and Spartaco. The four young men decide to start a business. They only need a van to start a transport company. But they lack the money. How can they get it?

Title: 860. Paris Follies of 1956
description: With just one night to prove that he's worth the investment, aspiring businessman Dan Bradley (Forest Tucker) does his best to put on an amazing musical at Hollywood's famed Moulin Rouge nightclub.

Title: 861. Gázolás
description: Judge András Csanádi tells his boss how he met and then fell in love with Judit Zenthe, the pretty, modern driver, in a fencing hall. She returned his feelings in an unexpected way. One night, crying, she confessed that she had caused a serious car accident. The case was given to Csanádi, who, despite his feelings, wanted to investigate the circumstances conscientiously. This is how Judit's hidden life and is revealed to him.

Title: 862. Wine of Morning
description: Have you ever wondered about Barabbas, the man whom the mob chose instead of Christ? How he became a murderer and an outlaw? What happened to him after Pilate released him and condemned Jesus Christ to die on his cross?

Title: 863. The Infiltrator
description: Mariani, a Corsican gangster, sympathizes with his cellmate, Léo, a police inspector who poses as an inmate. When Léo is to be released, Mariani hand him a letter to bring to his wife Elaine.

Title: 864. Hotel Adlon
description: The story of Germany's most famous hotel, located in central Berlin. It is shown in several plots and subplots showing famous and not so famous guests of the hotel and its demise at the end of World War II.

Title: 865. Gengæld
description: The widow Elise lives in a large villa with her adult son Eigil and their tenants, among others an impoverished writer and a rich manufacturer. One day a certain Mr. Schmidt comes to visit and claims to be Eigil's father. Elise denies it, but that's not the only secret Schmidt thinks he has. And before the evening is over, the villa is transformed into a crime scene.

Title: 866. Police Dog
description: London cop Frank becomes dog-handler after colleague's death. His canine partner Rex intrudes on his home life with girlfriend Pat. Frank hopes killer resurfaces to solve case.

Title: 868. Tales of Ginza
description: When she was a little girl, Wakako Kyoguku's portrait was painted by a talented young artist. Years later, she takes it to an art gallery in Ginza, in hopes of reuniting with the creator whom she never knew the name.

Title: 869. Frente al pecado de ayer
description: In Cuba, a rich young man falls in love with a beautiful humble "guajira" (country girl) but his powerful father uses all the means within his reach to end the relationship, including framing the girl and jailing her for attempted murder.

Title: 870. Das fröhliche Dorf
description: Farmer Lemken doesn't accept the obligation to pay taxes and refuses to do so. In consequence his best breeding sow Jolanta shall be sold in forced auction. But the whole village stands together and helps him to hide the pig. The young teacher Dr. Meinert, who's in love with Lemken's daughter Anna, tries to help him too, in the formally correct way.

Title: 872. The Delavine Affair
description: A man's death leads a local newspaperman and the man's girlfriend to seek the killer.

Title: 873. La sospechosa
description: Regina de Alba returns home from a trip to Europe, only to learn that her mother left suddenly, but she suspects that her step father has something to do with her sudden disappearance, through her own investigations she learns of her step father's criminal past and the truth about what happened to her mother.

Title: 874. Das Fräulein von Scuderi
description: Several men have been murdered lately, mostly rich lovers on their way to meet their mistresses with gifts of fine jewelry. To fight this scourge, King Louis XIV decides to create a special court named "La chambre ardente", designed to find and punish the perpetrators of such heinous crimes. An unexpected person, Mademoiselle de Scudéry, the famous poetess, will find herself entangled in the web of a criminal intrigue linked with the jewel murders, along with a a goldsmith, his daughter and her fiancé...

Title: 875. The First Kiss
description: Omnibus feature with three independent stories.

Title: 876. Das Schweigen im Walde
description: A nobleman going incognito rescues a woman from fire and from a desperate forester in the Bavarian Alps.

Title: 877. Panchthupi: A Village in West Bengal
description: It is a documentary based on the "Durgapuja" festival in a village called Panchthupi located in West Bengal, India.

Title: 878. The Accomplices
description: Giovanni peddles useless pens in the streets of Rome with his sidekick Francesco, but his college-student daughter thinks he is a rich industrialist. She falls in love with a rich guy and when her father tells her the trust about their financial situation she drops her fiance and refuses food. Luckily, the guy's parents give their consent to the marriage anyway.

Title: 879. Les chiffonniers d'Emmaüs
description: At the end of the 1940s, Abbé Pierre decided to build an inn for the homeless. During the construction of the Emmaus hostel, he got to know many individuals in need that he was going to take under his wing.

Title: 880. Ingrid - The Story of a Fashion Model
description: Ingrid, a young and inexperienced girl, is elected "Miss Mannequin". The photojournalist Walter is happy because he is her friend, the journalist Robert, because he senses a good story.

Title: 881. Al fin solos
description: Rafael is a young scientist who is going to marry Teresa, his lifelong girlfriend. But on his wedding day he is mistaken for the inventor of a revolutionary fuel and a crazy chase begins to steal the formula.

Title: 882. The Hornet's Nest
description: In this comedy adventure, a jewel thief hides his latest goods in a deserted barge, but ends up in jail. Two young models then buy the barge, and with the help of two little old ladies, find the jewels and claim the reward.

Title: 883. Je suis un sentimental
description: Michel was just released from prison when he is suspected of having killed his wife as she was the one who brought him into prison. She also betrayed him with Rupert, a journalist not wanting to become a part of the newspaper stories. Thus Rupert asks the reporter Barney to find proof for Michel's innocence. But the police already sees Michel back in prison.

Title: 884. Conflict
description: Friction between work and marriage.

Title: 885. Prigionieri del male
description: A young communist discovers the power of faith.

Title: 887. Kontra-Bida
description: NOW AT LAST - The powerful story of two men bound by ties closer than those of blood-brothers.

Title: 888. El amor nunca muere
description: Three stories connected by a valuable medallion as it passes from hand to hand through the years.

Title: 889. Last of the Desperados
description: After killing Billy the Kid, Sheriff Pat Garrett is relentlessly dogged by members of the Kid's gang.

Title: 890. Carolina Cannonball
description: Judy and her grandpa run a trolley between a train depot and a ghost town in Nevada, near the California border. Three spies intent of tracking down an atomic missile gone astray arrive. When the trolley breaks down, Judy and Grandpa unwittingly install the engine from the nearby crashed missile.

Title: 891. Heimatland
description: Somewhere in the Salzburg mountains, young poacher Hans tries to conquer the heart of pretty schoolteacher Helga but is overthrown by forest warden Thomas. Krambambuli, the dog he once saved from being drowned, indirectly causes his death.

Title: 892. Görünmeyen adam Istanbul'da
description: A man who works in a chemistry lab, learns that his wife deceives himself. He uses invisibility serum to revenge from his wife and wife's lover.

Title: 893. Dunja
description: Beautiful Dunja is bored at the post office of her father, far in the depths of Russia. Sie accompanies the dubious officer Minski to St. Petersburg, he gets tired of her, and she ends up as a prostitute. Her father wants to take revenge.

Title: 894. Al diablo las mujeres
description: Rosa, a mayor, faces pressure from her police chief father to imprison her cousins. After a kidnapping and tampering with vaccines, Rosa realizes politics isn't for women.

Title: 895. Sommarflickan
description: Britta is the foster daughter of Professor Rydberg. The last 13 years she has lived with him and his son Sven. She and Sven are closely not only at the siblings' way. They are engaged.

Title: 896. Lost Continent
description: An Italian documentary film about maritime Southeast Asia including Borneo.

Title: 897. Yetim yavrular
description: Fikret and Sevim, who fall into the hands of a cruel stepmother, run away from home. Farm owner Hasan Bey adopts them. Hasan's wife Nesrin loves Fikret and the two siblings have to separate from each other.

Title: 898. The Killer Lust
description: After a man-killing leopard, or skabenga, begins terrorizing native villages and ravaging herds in South Africa, the government calls in a professional hunter to track down and slay the beast.

Title: 901. Adriana Lecouvreur
description: When famous actress Adriana Lecouvreur is attacked by criminals, she is saved by the timely intervention of Maurice of Saxony; a passionate love springs up between them.

Title: 902. Il coraggio
description: A wealthy trader saves the life of a poor suicidal man who then decides that his savior has the responsibility of taking care of him and his family.

Title: 903. Altid ballade
description: Early Danish kitchen sink drama by Academy Award winner Gabriel Axel with an entertaining mix of working class daily life, children rivalry, crime and romance.

Title: 904. Sin la sonrisa de Dios
description: Francisco Martín Segura, better known as "Piquín", is a street urchin with serious behavior problems. At school he is about to be expelled for the fights he provokes. But things change with the arrival of Mr. Ponce, a young teacher who applies revolutionary educational techniques. To begin with, he entrusts Piquín to be his secretary.

Title: 905. Native Drums
description: A team of doctors sets out through a steamy African jungle to check an outbreak of sleeping sickness.

Title: 909. Romeo & Juliet
description: Russian ballet version of Shakespeare's tragedy about star-crossed lovers from two feuding Italian Renaissance families.

Title: 910. Shadow of a Man
description: After a fight, a drunk is found dead, but is the cause of death heart failure or murder?

Title: 911. On Faith and Law
description: Grete and Hans are happily married and have no worries. Right up until a tax bill is dumped in the letterbox. It reveals that it would be cheaper for them if they were divorced. In faith and law, therefore, they get a divorce. But being in love and divorced turns out to be harder than they planned.

Title: 912. Navy Heroes
description: The title is derived from the flag of England's Outward Bound Sea School at Aberdovey, Wales: Mike Merriworth, a Merchant Navy hero of the Korean War returns to England after three years of captivity in Communist hands, his mind confused by brainwashing and indoctrination at the hands of his captors, and accepts a post as an instructor at the Outward Bound Sea School. He is placed in charge of "Nelson Watch," which consists of 12 boys from all walks of British life, including the usual juvenile delinquent, a dictatorial bully, and a kid afraid of heights. He is a harsh commander and fails to appreciate some of their problems in light of what he has been through.

Title: 913. Quest for the Lost City
description: A documentary account of the hardships and adventures encountered by an American couple seeking the ruins of an ancient Mayan city in the jungles north of the Guatemala-Mexico border.

Title: 914. Cold Nights
description: Cold Nights features great performances by both Pak Yin as a tough minded "new woman", Shusheng, and Ng Cho-fan as her weak husband, Wang Wenxuan, whose spirits have been crushed by the Sino-Japanese war.

Title: 915. Fruits of Summer
description: Sabine Gravières, married to Edouard, the High Commissioner for Criminal Youth, has a problem: Juliette, her daughter, is not only pregnant but she also refuses to marry Claude, the young man who got her pregnant. It is fair to say that the model set by Juliette's parents is far from ideal. Aware at last of the problem, Sabine decides to try and make it up with her husband...

Title: 916. Punta a ctyrlístek
description: The protagonist of the story is a third-grader, Toník Burda, who tries to improve his image in the eyes of his friends through a fox terrier.

Title: 917. The Noble Experiment
description: An amateur biochemist, successful with a chemical 'get-along pill' for his mother-in-law, pours a barrel full of the concoction into the city water supply.

Title: 918. El pecado de ser mujer
description: Javier Morales is a singer-songwriter who seduces Maria Luisa, a young woman who he gets pregnant and then abandons. Twenty years later, Javier falls into poverty, along with a recurrent alcohol consumption problem. After he's mistakenly declared dead, he ends up going to his own funeral, without knowing an unexpected event is about to happen.

Title: 919. La reina mora
description: During the April Fair, in the Seville neighborhood of Santa Cruz, Antonio, in love with Coral, confronts Esteban, her boyfriend. The end result is that Antonio ends up wounded and Esteban in jail. To avoid gossip, Coral asks her brother to change their address. Cotufo agrees, and the two move to a mansion where, according to legend, a Christian man and the daughter of a Moorish king, who died of love, once lived.

Title: 921. Budapesti tavasz
description: Set during Christmas Eve in 1944, the film follows the story of Pintér and Gozsó, who manage to get through the Soviet blockade around Budapest. Pintér seeks refuge in a flat he believed was abandoned by his relatives, only to discover that the Turnovszkys are hiding there, along with a Jewish woman named Jutka. As the narrative unfolds, a love story develops between Zoltán and Jutka amidst the backdrop of war-torn Budapest.

Title: 922. Neokonchennaya povest
description: A female doctor and a male patient begin to develop feelings for each other, while the doctor's male colleague is infatuated with her as well.

Title: 923. Road to Life
description: In 1920 Poltava,, Ukraine, the first Soviet colony for street boys was created. This film tells the story of these rebellious kids and how the colony's director sought to rehabilitate them by allowing them to govern themselves.

Title: 926. Yasmin
description: A powerful, princely Sheikh lives in 18th-century Persia, making his living by renting out properties and recovering taxes and dues on them. He lives in a palatial house with his wife Zubeda and son Ahmad. When Ahmad grows up, Zubeda notices that he is spending too much time with women in their harem, and wants his father to get him involved in their business. Sheikh accordingly instructs Ahmad to collect all revenue, which he does. A few days later, Sheikh is informed that Ahmad has been spending time with a friend named Farid and is romantically involved with a dancing girl named Yasmin. A visibly upset Sheikh accordingly warns Ahmad to mend his ways, give up on Yasmin, and return home, where he has planned his marriage with Nadira, the daughter of Amir Qasim. Ahmad returns home but refuses to marry Nadira, then runs away from home to be close to be Yasmin, knowing very well that she is connected with a group of gypsy thugs who use her charms to lure wealthy young men to extract ransom. And Ahmad knows that his enraged father will also challenge him to a duel that will ensure a death in this family.

Title: 928. La gran obsesión
description: A Psychological Drama based Musical that depicts the aspirations of a young rural woman whom, attracted by the city life, seems to be in an inevitable collision course between two very different worlds. Her intent to enter a strange and hostile world may give rise to grave consequences.

Title: 929. Lo que nunca muere
description: Two brothers are separated, one remaining in Spain and later entering the Army, while the other is sent to Russia. When the Spanish Civil war breaks out they will unexpectedly reunite as the evacuated one is sent back to Spain to sabotage a dam in Morocco.

Title: 931. Barn av solen
description: Careless youth flirt and court in the sun at the beach. Based upon a play by the director, which was so unhappy with the result, that he doesn't want the film shown anymore.

Title: 932. Armas da Vingança
description: A young woman breaks off her engagement to marry her fiancé's brother instead, hoping to save her bankrupt father's farm-a decision that sparks family outrage and devastating consequences.

Title: 934. Egy pikoló világos
description: Marci has long had a crush on Julika, who lives in the same house as him, but before their love could blossom, he is drafted into the army. Juli is sent to work in a factory, where she falls in with the wrong crowd, often partying until dawn consuming "piccolo lights". After a year, Marci returns home and gets deeply disappointed in her and breaks up with her. But Juli loves him too and hopes that he will give her the security she needs to return to her old self.

Title: 935. Scuola elementare
description: Dante Trilli, who has been teaching in his village school for about twenty years, wins a competition for Milan. Waiting for him is his childhood friend, where he is the janitor in the school where Trilli will teach.

Title: 936. Son beste
description: Zeki has a beautiful voice but he is poor and is forced to sell his oud. In the music shop he meets Nermin. They fall in love. But Semra, a rich woman, is also interested in Zeki.

Title: 937. Het wonderlijke Leven van Willem Parel
description: Comedian Wim Sonneveld has had enough of his most popular character, Willem Parel the organ grinder. He feels his creation is becoming more popular than himself. Indeed, Parel proves to have enough life in him to step down from a dressing room poster into the real world. When he start to lead actual organ grinders from all over the country into lobbying for equal rights, the police naturally, go after Wim Sonneveld.

Title: 938. Pecado mortal
description: A wealthy woman loses her sight and is forced to give up her daughter.

Title: 939. Io piaccio
description: Roberto Maldi, a young scientist, is trying to find a serum capable of giving courage but he unwittingly invents a serum which transforms any man in a womanizer. His boss scents a good business and wants to produce the serum on industrial basis, but Roberto does not agree.

Title: 940. Der Cornet - Die Weise von Liebe und Tod
941. Ich war ein häßliches Mädchen
description: Anneliese is an ugly duckling until the well-known actor Claudio takes care of her, gives her a job in a fashion store and sends her to a beauty salon.

Title: 942. Kilo tissa wa tissaine
description: A man works two jobs-truck driver by day and nightclub singer by night. While driving near Kilometer 99, British occupation forces arrest him. A café worker who witnesses the event decides to help him escape.

Title: 944. Hou chuang
description: Adapted from Alfred Hitchcock's "Rear Window" 1954 film by a collective of Cantonese filmmakers to commemorate the death of comedian Yi Qiushui.

Title: 945. Forever Yours
description: Based on a Thai classic novel by Riam-Eang, the film depicts a forbidden love story of Yupadee and Sang-Mong who believe that love is forever. Yupadee is a beautiful lady who married to Papo, an old but wealthy man who owns the Camp Wood in Kampangpetch province.

Title: 947. Lapu-Lapu
description: LVN's top stars Delia Razon and Mario Montenegro were reunited for the nth time in this 1955 Lamberto Avellana's monumental epic, "Lapu-Lapu". Based form the celebrated Francisco V. Coching's Pilipino Komiks serial novel, the movie tells of the courageous and fierce stand put up by Lapu-Lapu and his men against the Spanish invaders led by Ferdinand Magellan in what was dubbed as the 'Battle of Mactan'.

Title: 948. I quattro del getto tonante
description: In post-war Italy, some pilots of the Air Force, despite the difficulties in which they are forced to operate, manage to form an acrobatic squadron. From the dedication of these men will be born the "Frecce Tricolori", the Italian Air Force's acrobatic squadron.

Title: 949. Daglari Bekleyen Kiz
description: Captain Adnan is after a smuggling gang. While trying to catch the gang on crime, Adnan meets Zeynep, the daughter of the head of the gang, and falls in love with her.

Title: 950. Broadway Jungle
description: In Hollywood, fledgling director, harassed by the landlord for rent, explains that he has finally found a backer for his new movie, "Death Takes a Spree", and so should soon be flush.

Title: 951. Soy un golfo
description: A young woman in love with a modest worker faces pressure from her aunt to marry a wealthy suitor instead.

Title: 955. Rhythm and Blues Revue
description: Extravaganza with lots of music legends from the 50s.

Title: 956. 2x2 néha 5
description: A pilot who wants to be an airplane designer and a scientist who wants to learn more about flying meets, fell into love, flies over a mountain, and sings a lot.

Title: 957. Darb al-mahabil
description: Literary adaptation: A simple minded man has the luck of a winning lottery ticket.Others try to take advantage of him by snatching his money away from him.

Title: 959. Er nu zhai
description: Before he was known internationally as a martial arts superstar, Bruce Lee had appeared in a handful of Hong Kong films as a child star in the 1940s/50s. One of these early films was The More the Merrier (1955), a.k.a. We Owe it to Our Children from the Union Film Enterprise, a family melodrama written and directed by renowned filmmaker Chin Chien (My Intimate Partners). Featuring the 14-year-old Bruce Lee and future Cantonese Opera star Yuen Siu Fai, the B&W film revolves around accountant Ming (played by Cheung Wood Yau) and his wife (Tsi Lo Lin) who suffers a miscarriage in an car accident. The couple decides to adopt a baby girl, not knowing that she's the daughter given up by Ming's poor co-worker who struggles to feed a bunch of kids. Bruce Lee plays the slacker son of the landlord (Ko Lo Chuen).

Title: 961. Thawrat el-Madinah
description: Fatmah's mother dies when she gives birth to her. Her father observes that women in her family die when they give birth to their first child. Fatmah lives captive to her father's wrong idea that if she marries and has children, she will die and her destiny will be like that of her mother. To avoid her this fate, her father keeps her away from any man. However, Fatmah falls in love with Ahmad without her father's knowledge and is hesitant to marry him because that is where her life will be destroyed. Events follow.

Title: 962. Nicht mehr fliehen
description: In a desolate, destroyed landscape - bearing now irrelevant traces of technological society - a man and a boy try to find their way under a fierce sun.

Title: 965. Dong Cunrui
description: Dong Cunrui is a young soldier of PLA. This movies describes his growth from a common civilian into a brave soldier and his heroic sacrifice of life in the destruction of the enemy's blockhouse.

Title: 968. Gueule d'ange
description: Angel Face, a handsome young gigolo, supports himself by selling the gifts given to him by his lovers. One of his women, Marie, tells him that she is pregnant, hoping that this will have a stabilizing effect on him, but he is merely annoyed at her naivety and leaves her. Despondent over the loss of her lover, Marie has an accident that causes a miscarriage. Later, Angel Face meets a man in a bar who tells him of Loina, a beautiful woman who preys upon the men who love her. Angel Face decides to take the challenge and meets Loina, who invites him to join her in selling forged artwork. He attempts to make love with her and she agrees, with the stipulation that he not become jealous of her other sexual encounters. The arrangement succeeds for awhile, but finally the love-sick Angel Face pleads with Loina for them to both stop their promiscuous behaviour. She refuses to be possessed solely by Angel Face and leaves him. Angel Face is heartbroken but soon realizes that he has done the same thing to women many times before.

Title: 969. Fue-fuki waka musha
description: A Romeo & Juliet type story of tragic love set to the Heian Period. A young samurai wins the heart of a beautiful princess with his wonderful flute playing, which sets in motion a feud that will change the face of Japan.

Title: 970. 'Las viudas del cha-cha-cha'
description: They had always wanted to dance in public, but their husbands-orchestra conductor Alberto and agent Servando-would never allow it.

Title: 971. Bröderna Östermans bravader
description: Business manager Svensson has to spend time with the Österman brothers at a small island in the Stockholm archipelago.

Title: 973. Wunschkonzert
description: Accountant and would-be song-writer Willy inadvertently gets into a live TV game show and is tasked with finding, presenting and performing with a motley band of six amateur musicians within 90 minutes.

Title: 974. Adiós muchachos
description: Boyhood friends grow up, form a tango orchestra, one of them writes a brilliant song commemorating their friendship before he dies.

Title: 977. The Grasshopper
description: Osip Ivanovich Dymov, the titular counselor and the doctor of thirty one years, serves in two hospitals at the same time: intern and anatomist. From nine o'clock in the morning and in the forenoon accepts patients, then goes to open corpses. But its income is hardly enough for a covering of expenses of the wife mad about talents and celebrities in the art and artistic environment whom it daily accepts in the house.

Title: 978. Bruden fra Dragstrup
description: At Helene Dragstrup's 20th birthday, her grandmother Margrethe decides that it is time that Helene learns something about life outside the protective walls of the estate.

Title: 979. The Echelon of Doctor M.
description: Continuing their exploits against the Yugoslav National Liberation Army, the Ballists attack an echelon of wounded warriors led by Dr. M. He takes the wounded to a nearby town. Aware that the justice is on the side of Doctor M., Ramadan, son of one of the Ballist leaders, joins him and contributes to defeat of the Ballists.

Title: 980. Die Stadt ist voller Geheimnisse
description: Adapted from a stage play by Curt J. Braun, the film takes place in a mid-sized German industrial town. When the local factory closes its doors, the townsfolk are thrown into confusion and dismay. The story concentrates on a dozen laid-off workers, relating their individual life stories and detailing their hopes, aspiration and fears.

Title: 982. Farligt löfte
description: A woman is murdered and a little girl is the only one who can reveal the perpetrator.

Title: 983. La pícara molinera
description: Film based on the popular romance of the 'Molinero de Arcos'.

Title: 984. Wenn die Alpenrosen blüh'n
description: Beate Klockenhoff lässt sich von ihrem viel beschäftigten Mann Philipp scheiden.

Title: 987. Treize à table
description: Thirteen is unlucky on Christmas Eve dinner.

Title: 988. Alarma in munti
description: The border guards face spies parachuted into Romania to recover and take abroad the secret documents of a forestry plant.

Title: 989. Mädchen ohne Grenzen
description: Helga, a stewardess, meet a passenger,Eriic, during a flight to Athens. They fall in love, but he is married. Later Helga is involved in a flight crash. One of the severely injured passengers is Eric's wife Maria.

Title: 991. Les Duraton
description: Jules Duraton is the headmaster of Chatelbourg's high school. He is happily married, has a teenage daughter named Solange, and everything would be for the best of all possible worlds if he and his family were not the namesakes of the protagonists of a famous comic series broadcast every day on Radio Monde "La Famille Duraton". Day after day, the real-life Duratons are made fun of because of their surname and Jules just can't take it any more. That is why he decides to sue the radio station responsible for his misfortune...

Title: 992. Yolpalas Cinayeti
description: The story of Naciye, who became rich after her marriage.

Title: 993. Desfasurarea
description: Based on the story of the same name by Marin Preda. The film tells about the struggle of the poor peasants against the rural rich for the creation of a collective farm.

Title: 995. Miss Coca Cola
description: Ganga, who becomes a night club dancer called Miss Coca Cola when her father is implicated in a murder case. Helped by Kamal, a rich young man, she is able to prove her father's innocence.

Title: 998. The Youth
description: In the latter years of the Korean Empire, Lee In Hwa, disguises herself as a man so she can join a group of young men determined to overthrow the colonial government.

Title: 999. La venganza de los Villalobos
description: The three Villalobos brothers are given the task of going to the city and cash the collection of garments made by the farmers.

Title: 1000. Der Ochse von Kulm
description: A man is put on trial after his ox attacks some foolish Ami's.
